Subaru: [Yeah yeah, like Ceci.]

Cecilus’s characteristic way of wording things was difficult to understand, but when deciphered, Subaru found there was a lot to be impressed by in how he perceived the true nature of things and how his way of thinking got to the heart of matters.

Even if it was an imperfect manifestation, Cecilus had repelled the Witch who assailed the Gladiator Island along with Chisha, and had exclaimed, “My long-awaited grand performance!” as he cheerfully left the island, and for better or worse had been waiting in the Imperial Capital for his turn on stage without a care in the world.

The specific particulars on how Cecilus had gained a young form were unclear to him, but if even things such as his ways of thinking or feeling had also been made young, Subaru wondered if it might be the case that when he one day returned to his original form, he might lose his current vibrant sensibilities. If that was the case, he thought that would be regrettable.

Chisha: [Do not worry yourself, I suppose Cecilus has always been that way.]

Subaru: [No kidding. Then I’m… well I can’t say I’m relieved, since I’ll be worried in the opposite sense. The First, Ceci is like that, the Second, Arakiya-chan is how she is, Vollachia sure managed to keep running, huh?]

Chisha: [All of that is due to His Excellency the Emperor Vincent Vollachia’s management. ――Consequently, I am not confident in the success of this endeavor. In truth, I suppose it has been riddled with unforeseen occurrences.]

Subaru: [Like my appearance.]

Chisha: [You said it yourself.]

The corners of his mouth relaxed, and Chisha gave a small chuckle at Subaru’s words.

Talking about unforeseen circumstances, Subaru would not lose out to Chisha. From the beginning, since they were sent to the Vollachian Empire, not a single thing had gone as expected.

Subaru: [If I had to say anything, it’s that Natsumi Schwartz’s existence has been proven to the Empire after the Kingdom, I guess.]

Chisha: […I do not believe I possess the qualification to say this after so thoroughly using it, but I do doubt whether you learned those skills in the Kingdom.]

Subaru: [Ahh, the level-up of my skills was developed in Lugunica, but I acquired those skills elsewhere. In my hometown, beyond the so-called Great Waterfall… Oops. Beako kept getting upset with me, saying that putting it like that would cause misunderstandings, but I did it again.]

Chisha: [Beyond the Great Waterfall. ――I see, I understand now.]

Subaru felt his fingers tremble from a lack of Beatromin, and beside him Chisha nodded as if he was impressed in some way by what he had said. Based on the flow of the conversation, it wasn’t regarding Subaru/Schwartz, but rather the topic after that. ――It was probably about the Great Waterfall.

Chisha: [All along, I have held some doubts. As a citizen of the Kingdom, it was natural that your values differed from ours in the Empire, Natsuki-dono, but even so, the divergence was too large.]

Subaru: [The divergence was… too large?]

Chisha: [To speak bluntly, you overvalue the worth of lives. ――Or, to be more precise, I suppose I should say the worth of other people’s lives.]

Subaru blinked as Chisha spoke those words while he traced his own slender jaw with a finger.

The worth of lives, of course such a thing would have great significance. Everyone had but a single life. There may be exceptions, but setting those exceptions aside, that was an absolute truth.

And it was for that reason, he wished that no opportunities would be stolen from any lives.

Subaru: [Even you, Chisha-san, saved me in Chaosflame, you know? Back then, thanks to you tearing off the “mask” of the Emperor and donning Ferris’s, you linked together the unforeseen circumstances of unforeseen circumstances.]

Chisha: [That was simply due to the fact that there was merit in using you, Natsuki-dono. If I were to speak using my own standards of value, it was simply that the loss of allowing you to die there felt far greater. However, you do not see things in such terms of advantages and disadvantages. I suppose the reason for this is the sense of values at your core.]

Subaru: […I get that things like the soil and water you grew up with can change how you view the world. Since I hate the Empire.]

Chisha: [Haha, you say it so clearly it is almost refreshing.]

Subaru: [I hate the Empire. I hate it, but I can’t bring myself to completely hate everyone on that soil. That’s the sort of standards of value I have, though.]

That was not a particularly special mindset, or at least Subaru did not think so.

Of course, Subaru was well aware that his ideals were naive compared to the values of the Kingdom of Lugunica, much less the values of the fierce and harsh Vollachian Empire. Even after living in another world for over a year, he did not feel like he would ever get used to the exchange of lives.

To a certain extent, he accepted that it was inevitable that this would be used as a reason for disappointment. On the other hand, when used as a reason for praise, he couldn’t help but think it was not such a big deal.

Subaru: [First of all, you believe me, Chisha-san? That I came from beyond the Great Waterfall?]

Chisha: [Words I have never seen nor heard before, your way of thinking, some skills, and those values. A Witch Cultist who managed to learn social skills while being raised in a senseless environment―― Well, if I had to use such a dreadful description, I would more easily preserve the tranquility of my heart by saying they were a visitor from beyond the Great Waterfall.]

Subaru: [Seriously? Is it information that, If you don’t convince yourself to that level , you can’t balance the scales?… I should’ve taken Beako more seriously…]

For Chisha, it was apparently a story on the level of him only believing it because it was preferable to Subaru being a Witch Cultist.

Even the Emilia Camp tended to be the type to more or less let Subaru’s history go in one ear and out the other, so he was grateful that Chisha believed him, even if it was through dubious logic, but from now on, he intended to be much more careful in how he broached such subjects.

Subaru: [I’m sure glad we had this talk before I carelessly reminisced about my past with Rem. I’ve been slowly building just a bit of momentum, but my favorability almost crashed again. Even though I’m already at rock bottom.]

Chisha: [It has been oddly low up to now.]

Rem’s feelings fluctuated and were hard to evaluate, and Chisha’s comment was sympathetic to that.

Over the course of opening up to each other, he had told Chisha that Rem had become a victim of the Sin Archbishop of Gluttony, and as a result had forgotten her connection with Subaru.

Though, now that he thought about how the previous conversation regarding his connection to the Great Waterfall had been received, there was also the possibility Chisha had only believed this since it was preferable to Subaru being an evil stalker with a complicated attachment to Rem.

Chisha: [Originally, I had had no intention of recalling Cecilus.]

Subaru: [Huh?]

Subaru’s eyes widened as he was caught off guard by the atmosphere of the sudden change in the flow of the conversation.

When he looked, Chisha had placed his sake cup on the railing of the balcony, and while opening and closing his now vacant hand, with his golden eyes he gazed upon the Crystal Palace―― no, the very Imperial Capital itself.

Given the change in atmosphere, Subaru also set down his cup and looked out upon the same scene.

Chisha: [As you may have already grasped, I changed him into that youthful form with my Noh. It was for good reason that I sent him to the Gladiator Island like that. And that, along with everything else was――]

Subaru: [To prepare for the coming Great Disaster, right? I don’t get what you stood to gain from shrinking Ceci and tossing him onto an island, but… Ah, wait, maybe, was it the same as with Goz-san?]

Chisha: [You are not far from the mark, thus I shall leave it at that. After all, no one can stand on the same level as Cecilus Segmunt. ――Aside from the Sword Saint and the Admirer and such.]

Subaru: […Your name is coming up even here, you are truly worldwide , Reinhard.]

As a matter of fact, Subaru had seen with his own eyes that Cecilus’s strength was something that deviated from the norm.

During the battle against the Witch that had unfolded, the true value of the Blue Lightning had certainly been demonstrated. ――However, it had not been the young Cecilus himself who had demonstrated this, but rather Chisha, having donned that “mask” and played the role of an adult Cecilus.

To Subaru’s eyes, as one who had seen Reinhard’s transcendent combat up close twice before, he certainly believed that the ability of the adult Cecilus could be placed in the same realm of the transcendent.

However――,

Subaru: [If we’re only talking about strength, then sure, but there are more qualifications beyond just that necessary to stand alongside him.]

Chisha: [――. What do you mean by those words?]

Subaru: [Well, when Chisha-san and Ceci challenged that huge shadow on Ginunhive, it might have just been due to me having the heroine mentality of Natsumi Schwartz, but I could feel it. ――That these two, standing side-by-side, are the strongest of the Empire.]

Chisha: [――――]

Subaru: [I’m not just saying this because you had transformed into an adult Ceci, Chisha-san, got it? The dependability I felt then wasn’t that sort of thing. It’s like, the reason you win isn’t just because you’re strong, that sort of perspective is completely different… I can’t put it into words very well!]

Scratching his head, Subaru searched for a way to convey the passion of that moment.

Unlike just being strong because they were strong, and also unlike equating them because they were both the same strength, it was more like one plus one not equalling two, but some much greater number; it was that sort of extraordinary feeling.

Subaru: [Honestly, you’ve been so selfish. Even supposing he found out Chisha-san’s true intentions, His Excellency the Emperor might get so upset he would never forgive you. For my part, I believe Emperor Vincent is a lucky man though.]

Chisha: [His Excellency is a lucky man, you say? On that, I suppose we agree.]

Subaru: [Oh, not being humble about that?]

Chisha: [An accurate grasp of the capabilities of others, not to mention my own, is an essential measure of my role in the Empire. Above all, those who do not intend to make their true strength known shall only be devoured in this land of Sword Wolves.]

Subaru: [A society of super-efficiency, a super-meritocracy, a principle of super-competitiveness… I get it, but I have a bit of hope that Vollachia isn’t a place only defined by that.]

Saying that, Subaru spun around and leaned his back against the railing, looking up at the night sky.

The Imperial Capital of Lupugana was modeled as a star-shaped fortress, with the shimmering Crystal Palace placed at its north, and a sky full of stars that sparkled above. Subaru squinted at those stars, whose names he did not know.

He did not know their names, these stars he did not recognize or have any connection with, this starry sky that by all rights he should never have seen, yet they seemed to him to be exactly the same as people he had met in Vollachia.

Subaru: [Berstetz-san is surprisingly passionate. You evaluated him as an ultra-imperialist, Chisha-san, but I think he’s a passionate person. Probably the type that secretly treasures promises and such. Madelyn-chan doesn’t often open up her heart to me, but I think she’s quite caring. I think it was good to have someone by her side. I get the sense that she’s kind of lost on what to do with such compassion, I guess?]

Chisha: [Well, well, I feel like that is somewhat too soft of a viewpoint… However, you have me quite intrigued, so I suppose I would like to hear more.]

Subaru: [It’s nothing outrageous. Even after losing one of his arms, Olbart-san hasn’t shown even a bit of tragic heroism, probably due to the wisdom of his years. He may act viciously, but it seems like he has a surprising amount of compassion for young people. I haven’t had the chance to properly chat with Mogurocchi yet, but truthfully I have high expectations that he might be the most honest person in the Empire.]

After accompanying them to Chaosflame, Olbart seemed to have taken his feelings of guilt into consideration, wondering if he could attach a weapon where his lost arm had been. Since Subaru was constantly outside the city, he had had little contact with Moguro, who was in charge of guarding the Crystal Palace, but he was caring in a particularly quiet way, and often worried about Arakiya, who had left their side, and Goz, who was imprisoned.

Subaru: [As for Kafma-san, ever since the healing magic Rem remembered how to use worked on him, he’s become Rem’s biggest fan, which is honestly hilarious. But, given how much I’m running about, I’m grateful that there are those like Madelyn-chan who care about Rem. And, as for Ubilk… ah, well, how can I put it? He acts as a lubricant for the organization…]

Chisha: [If you cannot think of anything, I do not believe you should have to search for any good points in vain.]

Subaru: [Well, Ceci is Ceci, so I’ll skip that… And then there’s you, Chisha-san.]

Chisha: [――――]

Subaru: [It’s been one thing after another since I was sent to the Empire, but Chisha-san was always saving me… Or manipulating me? I was forced to go along with it…]

Chisha: [Wherever you fall on the matter, you shall not get any regret from me.]

Chisha stated so with a sigh toward Subaru, who was still uncertain in his evaluation.

Putting any manipulation or forced accompaniment aside, even the evaluation that he had been saved was deemed as vexing; Chisha Gold just had that sort of hard-to-please disposition.

However, that too, was a part of the partner whom he had spent so long with in such a short time.

Subaru: [For better or worse, you’ve been involved in eighty percent of my events in the Empire, Chisha-san. To me, the Vollachian Empire equals Chisha Gold.]

Chisha: [Discourteous. This is the Land of the Sword Wolf, and the Vollachian Empire is none other than the land of His Excellency, Emperor Vincent Vollachia himself, thus I pray you shall amend your belief.]

Shrugging his shoulders while joking, the rebel who ousted that very Emperor Vincent Vollachia from the throne, and threw the Empire into chaos due to his own wishes said such a thing.

To that, Subaru responded with “ Nice joke ,” and the two laughed together for a moment.

And then――,

Subaru: [This may well also be a flag or foreshadowing, so I’m unsure whether I should say it, but… well, after you achieve your goal, what will you do, Chisha-san?]

Chisha: [What, do you mean?]

Subaru: [Well, since you’ve done what you’ve done, even if you were to reveal everything, we don’t know whether Emperor Vincent would forgive you, right Chisha-san? That’s why… you know. If there’s no place for you left in the Empire, I could show you around the Kingdom this time!]

Chisha: [Hoh, you, Natsuki Subaru from beyond the Great Waterfall, shall show me the Kingdom of Lugunica?]

Subaru: [I’ve been living in the Kingdom for over a year now, so I can at least show you around the area!]

At any rate, if he was able to bring Rem back to the Kingdom of Lugunica, he wanted to not only help her recall her Memories, but also to journey around to the places she had been acquainted with.

Of course, since there was also the matter of Emilia’s Royal Selection, he did not have a lot of free time. Subaru felt it would not be so bad if Emilia, Beatrice, and a white Sword Wolf driven from the Empire were a part of such a journey.

Chisha: [As it is, in the position of supporting someone burdened with the complications of being a half-elf, I believe the way you extend your hand in that manner is perhaps a bit too unprincipled. If it is to this extent, I suspect the coordinator of the camp you are a part of, Natsuki-dono, surely has a lot of trouble piling up.]

Subaru: [Guh… It’s fine! It’s his own nature to take on troubles, and ‘cuz he told me to say anything without worrying about appearances!]

Chisha: [“‘Cuz”, huh?]

He had responded with a pretty reasonable rebuttal, and Subaru frowned.

Did the way he changed the topic ultimately mean Subaru had been rejected? Of course, he knew offering a prospect after being chased out of the Empire to Chisha, who was standing firm for the future of the Empire, was an insensitive topic.

Subaru: [I don’t like it when people try to do something somehow by putting themselves in a so-called heroic last stand, where they have nowhere to return, or nowhere to belong. That’s why I will offer the hand that I want to offer.]

Chisha: [Natsuki-dono…]

Subaru: [There! Flag building on the eve of a decisive battle is over! That’s all I wanted to discuss… Ah, thank you for taking care of Rem’s life. Doing that for me really saved me. …It’s super complicated, but I’d also like to thank Louis for that.]

While Subaru was away from the Imperial Capital, it seemed like the bond between Rem and Louis had grown deeper and deeper.

So far, she had not committed a single Sin Archbishop-like evil, and if anything seemed to be devotedly dedicating herself to Rem, but he could not fathom the root of those actions. ――Even if she was not what she appeared to be, it was going to be a headache to figure out what to do with her when he brought Rem back to the Kingdom.

Perhaps how to deal with this headache was a matter to consult Otto about.

Chisha: [――――]

Then, while Subaru was planning to make Otto’s stomachache even worse in that way, Chisha furrowed his brow, which was unusual, then opened his lips like he was going to say something, before closing them. Opened, then closed. Three times.

This seemed to be born of some kind of hesitation, and Subaru tilted his head.

Subaru: [Chisha-san, did that raise some flags ?]

Chisha: [――. No, in fact I suppose it is the opposite. I nearly uttered something that could have been foreshadowing, thus I restrained myself. Cecilus and you almost got me there, Natsuki-dono.]

Subaru: [Ceci and I are in the same category!? Seriously!?]

Subaru’s eyes widened, taken aback by what Chisha had said with a chuckle. Without saying much about Subaru’s response, Chisha picked up the sake cup he had put on the railing and took a sip of the alcohol.

A man who, unbeknownst to anyone, had worked out a plan to repel the Great Disaster that would shake the very Empire, and perhaps may have to bear living with fingers pointing at him even after the truth became clear; the fruition of his battle, in which he had deceived even his own lord that he devoted his loyalty to, was now soon at hand.

While praying that wish would be successful, at the same time, a clear path to return to the Kingdom of Lugunica was finally in sight, Subaru also clenched his fists.

Then, driven by the heat welling up within him, he raised those fists up, and,

Subaru: [Let’s do it Chisha-san. This battle will be our victory!]

Chisha: [I am not the sort of person who can get that heated, but… I value that spirit.]

Saying so, Chisha raised his sake cup into the night without any momentum and brought his own fist up to Subaru’s.

This was a mutual struggle―― no, a relationship of complicity, born out of an absurdity neither desired. For the great liars who deceived the Vollachian Empire, it was a night of firm oaths.

――And it would be Natsuki Subaru and Chisha Gold’s final night together.

△▼△▼△▼△

With his shoulders shaken and his cheeks tapped, Natsuki Subaru was brought back to consciousness, only to find the place he had awoken was not his bedroom in Berstetz’s mansion, but to his astonishment, the inside of a cramped crate.

???: [Uuu!]

The one who had played a part in rousing Subaru with that high-pitched voice was Louis Arneb, who was stuffed into the jam-packed space just like Subaru.

Seeing Rem’s figure behind the beaming Louis, Subaru sprang up. He smacked his head hard against the ceiling of the box, the pain and heat making him yell “Owwww!”

And then――,

Rem: [――We are inside a dragon carriage headed toward the Kingdom of Lugunica. I heard them say so.]

Subaru: [Ha-, huh? But, why would we be? Because… no, because! The rebels are already here!]

Rem: [I don’t know either! It happened so suddenly. We were forcefully crammed into this dragon carriage, and… you wouldn’t wake up at all.]

Subaru: [Don’t be ridiculous, I’m good at getting up, so if there was a commotion like that, I’d immediately…]

Wake up , he was about to say, before confronting the reality that he actually had not. When he did, what flashed through Subaru’s mind was the milk he had drank the night before.

The milk he had been drinking while chatting with Chisha on the balcony of the Imperial Residence; it had been prepared by Chisha for Subaru, and right after they finished talking, he remembered being struck by sudden drowsiness. He had stumbled back to his assigned room, slept like a log there, and then――,

Subaru: [Chisha-san set me up…! What was I thinking… Am I an idiot? No, I am definitely an idiot. It’s obvious what Chisha-san is planning.]

It was certain. Chisha’s goal in orchestrating this situation was clear.

Chisha intended to do it alone. Up to this point, Chisha had been borrowing Subaru’s help to arrange the pieces on the board, and at the final moment, he had decided to remove Subaru from the game board, just like he had done to the Emperor, and begin the final battle against the Great Disaster by himself.

Had he intended this from the very start, and where such deception had come from; such cowardly and futile complaints whirled through his head―― and he shut them out.

At this very moment, there was no use in lamenting that which disappointed him.

Subaru: [We have to get out somehow…]

Rem: [I think that will be difficult. I’ve tried several times, but this box is sturdy, and it won’t budge at all. We’ll be released once we’ve crossed the border with the Kingdom… or so it seems.]

Subaru: [But then, we won’t make it in time for the decisive battle at the Imperial Capital! Hey! Heeey! Someone! Open this up! Open it! I am Natsumi Schwartz, the Empress Consort candidate of His Excellency, Emperor Vincent Vollachia!!]

Despite banging on the walls of the crate and protesting as Natsumi Schwartz, no response occurred in the dragon carriage. Obviously, they had been ordered by Chisha, who had orchestrated all of this, to not lend an ear to anything Subaru or the others might say upon waking.

Subaru: [――Tch, Invisible Providence.]

Gritting his teeth, Subaru activated the invisible arm within himself―― Invisible Providence, and intended to destroy the crate.

However, unlike the Sin Archbishop of Sloth who originally possessed this power, Subaru’s version was not much different from simply being a third arm, aside from it being unable to be seen. If Subaru could not break the walls with his two actual arms, then it would be just as impossible to do it with this one.

Subaru: [If only the box had a simple lock, I could have opened it with a bit of In Prov , but…]

Feeling nothing but his body creaking in recoil, Subaru gritted his teeth at the failure of his plan.

Beside the struggling Subaru, Rem wore a tense expression, having already repeatedly gone through a similar struggle and made several dents in the wall the size of the tip of her pinky finger. ――She, too, did not believe it was right to leave the Empire at a time like this.

Rem had been placed at Berstetz’s mansion as a hostage for Subaru, but during her life there, she had recalled how to use the healing arts, and became highly prized as an invaluable asset in the Empire.

Feeling that her work was fulfilling, Rem had been making relationships in the Empire in her own way. He had also heard that she had been able to make some friends as well.

Rem: [Madelyn-san and Katya-san, they will remain in the Imperial Capital, but I…]

She probably had not even been allowed to say farewell..

For Subaru too, he could not help but feel like the final words he exchanged with Chisha had been “I have to go to the bathroom before bed.” His extreme drowsiness aside, what a pathetic state of affairs.

Subaru: [Shit! Let us out! At least… at least talk to me about it! Don’t just go deciding things on your own!]

Louis: [Aaa, uu?]

Subaru: [Shut up! It’s always the case, but right now I really don’t have the time to deal with you!]

Subaru snapped at Louis, who had peered over from beside him with a look of concern as he slammed on the walls. He was aware that it was nothing more than him venting his anger, and even if she was a Sin Archbishop, he felt disgust rise up within himself for making her the target of his outburst.

Instead of Subaru, pathetic as he was, Rem softly hugged Louis from behind after she was yelled at.

And then――,

Louis: [Uuu?]

Rem: […I’m… not okay. I want to insist that I’m okay, so I don’t make Louis-chan worry, but right now… Both I, and this one…]

Louis: [Uau, eu. ――Aaa, uu.]

Held in a tight embrace, Louis blinked at the words of Rem, who had tears welling in her eyes. Then, as her expression seemed to stiffen slightly, she reached out her hand and touched Subaru.

Subaru clenched his teeth at that sensation. ――It happened immediately after that.

Subaru: [――Ah?]

In the next instant, his vision suddenly seemed to blur for a split second, and Subaru found himself plopped down on the road.

Subaru: [Eh, ah, eh? Out… outside, but this is way too far outside!]

Yelling in sheer incredulity, the flustered Subaru scrambled to his feet. And Subaru was not the only one taken aback by the unexpected phenomenon. Rem, who had been holding Louis, was also sitting there.

The three of them, in the same positions as in the box, were on the road――.

Subaru: [That was, a warp … a teleport? No way.]

Louis: [Uu!]

In front of Subaru, who intuitively knew the answer, it was Louis who was enthusiastically raising her hand.

That was the power held by Louis―― No, the power of the Authority of the Sin Archbishop of Gluttony. One of the Gluttonies at the Pleiades Watchtower had devoured the ability to teleport over short distances from someone. Using that, Louis had taken Subaru and Rem and slipped out of the dragon carriage.

Rem: [Louis-chan, amazing…]

Subaru: [It annoys me to straightforwardly praise you by calling it amazing, but in this case you did great! You, can you use that warp to return us all the way back to the Imperial Capital in one go!?]

Louis: [Uuu? Au, uuuauu.]

Subaru grabbed her shoulders eagerly and rocked her back and forth, causing Louis’s eyes to roll back in her head as she shook her head. Understanding that her response was a denial, Subaru felt a wave of bitter vexation.

He was grateful they had managed to escape the dragon carriage, but in all likelihood, they had probably already been taken quite far from the Imperial Capital. How long would it take to return to the Imperial Capital on foot now, especially accompanied by Rem, whose legs had yet to fully recover?

If anything, although he would feel bad for Rem, he could have her continue on past the border, while he returned to the Imperial Capital on his own―― it was as he thought of this plan.

Rem: [――――]

Suddenly, a high-pitched sound emitted from Rem, making Subaru spin around in surprise. Looking closer, he saw that the mysterious high-pitched note had come from something like a small whistle that Rem had brought to her lips.

As he wondered what it was, Rem informed the wide-eyed Subaru, “It’s a dragon bone whistle,”

Rem: [I received it from Madelyn-san. Back when I mended Madelyn-san’s clothes, she said she wanted to reward me, since those clothes were very precious to her. If I blow this whistle――]

Subaru: [If you blow that whistle… hey, whoa!?]

The answer to the call of the dragon bone flute Madelyn had gifted her came swooping down from the sky.

Could it have been one among the many flying dragons commanded by Madelyn, a dragonkin? Flying dragons have a ferocious temperament that made them entirely untamable by humans aside from a particular method of raising them; this one knelt before Rem, who still held the flute in her hands, and lowered its head, showing its intention to obey.

Perhaps, it had been instructed by Madelyn and ordered to obey Rem.

Subaru: [If this guy will give us a ride, then off to the Imperial Capital!]

Rem: [Just a moment ago, weren’t you making a plan to leave Louis-chan and me behind to return to the Imperial Capital alone?]

Subaru: [I’m sorry! But I didn’t mean anything bad by it! You’re just so important and dear to me!]

Rem: [Ha? I’m not giving you a ride though?]

Subaru: [I’ll say it as little as possible from now on! Just give me a ride!]

His inner conflict revealed by his impatience and agitation, a flustered Subaru pleaded with Rem. Sighing at Subaru’s remarks, Rem pulled Louis close with an outstretched hand, and,

Rem: [I have no clue how fast it will go. Please hold on tight.]

Subaru: [Gotcha! Despite everything, this is the first chance I’ve gotten to ride a flying dragon, but I guess now isn’t the time for that!]

Riding atop a living creature flying through the sky and soaring freely across the heavens, such was not a common experience. So far, the only time Subaru had flown through the sky under similar conditions was with Roswaal.

While harboring such trivial emotions, Subaru hugged Rem and Louis’s waists from behind, and suddenly hoisted the two of them up as he leapt onto the flying dragon’s back.

Then, offering a quick apology to the “Hey!” in protest from Rem,

Subaru: [We’re coming back, Imperial Capital! Don’t think we’ll just end our story by dropping out like this!]

△▼△▼△▼△

???: [――Chisha-san, the time is at hand.]

Right before the decisive battle at the Imperial Capital commenced, Ubilk, who had paid a visit to Chisha, declared this revelation.

Regarding the position of the Stargazers, those contacted by the heavenly Observers, who they call “stars”―― those existences who established the principles of this world and uphold absolute separation; Chisha felt disgusted.

Chisha: [ Contacted , and so on, it is all the influence of Natsuki-dono.]

Conscious of the words murmured in his own head, Chisha suddenly relaxed his lips.

Last night, Subaru and his companions Rem and Louis had been put to sleep and smuggled out of the Imperial Capital, and were now headed straight for the border between the Empire and the Kingdom. The soldiers, deeply loyal to Chisha, accepted the task without any explanation and unhesitatingly obeyed their orders that took them far from the battlefield.

Unexpectedly, Chisha was deeply moved by how much he had been blessed by the people around him.

???: [Of course, of course that would be the case! No matter what anyone says, I myself have come alongside you, so there is absolutely no room for doubt on that front!]

Chisha: […I am certain I already gave the orders to deploy, so I suppose I must wonder why you are still here.]

Then, Chisha furrowed his brow at the childish figure of the Blue Lightning whom he had encountered in the corridors of the Crystal Palace. However, holding out his hand as if such a question was naught but foolishness, Cecilus exclaimed, “ Nonsense !” Cecilus: [You know of me, don’t you? As one who strives to be the leading actor of this world, it’s guaranteed I‘ll certainly be on time to assume the spotlight. Indeed, it’s for such a reason I’m properly present here at the scene of a great battle that will shake the Empire!]

Chisha: [Is that not because Natsumi Schwartz-dono and I came to fetch you?]

Cecilus: [That! Right! There! I am telling you that it was guidance visiting me in my time of need. Hypothetically speaking, you know? Say, even if it hadn’t been you and Ma’am who came to get me! Or even if no one had come to get me! I surely would’ve ended up at this battlefield regardless. No matter what twist of fate may have come!]

Chisha: [As ever… Even a Stargazer conveys the messages of the stars in a slightly more refined way, but it matters not what is said to you.]

Cecilus: [Of course. How could someone with a weak, spineless character ever be loved as a charming leading actor? Even if one doesn’t carry a sword, everyone carries their own convictions. That’s not just limited to me, you and Ma’am are the same.]

Sternly thrusting his finger at him, Cecilus spoke with his usual tone. It was so overwhelmingly his usual self that, for just a moment, Chisha forgot the boy before him was currently shrunk in size.

Natsuki Schwartz, or “Ma’am” as Cecilus called him―― and by extension, Natsuki Subaru, certainly possessed the kind of conviction that could be called “naivety.”

If so, did Chisha Gold possess it? ――Conviction?

Cecilus: [You do. ――Since you are also one of the actors I have acknowledged.]

Chisha: [You were not the one who chose me. Allow me to make that much clear.]

Cecilus: [Gosh, how harsh. Ohoho, looks like the battle is about to begin, huh?]

Sniffing with his nose as he gazed out the window, Cecilus narrowed his blue eyes.

Chisha had no way of knowing whether it was merely a part of his performance, or if he had genuinely gotten a whiff of the scent of combat.

However, to the one who had spun around and was heading to conquer the battlefield as he had just been ordered to, Chisha called out “Cecilus” and――,

Chisha: [Forgive me, as I have already conveyed what I wanted to convey once already, but since it is important, there is one more thing.]

Cecilus: [Hoho, what might it be? Please give the leading actor a lively send-off before he heads out onto the battlefield!]

Chisha: [Those were surprisingly pleasant days, driving the dragon carriage with you and getting its wheels stuck in a rut. ――I pray for your good fortune in battle, Cecilus Segmunt.]

Cecilus: [――――]

Yes, his own voice had sounded far calmer than he had expected, and Chisha quietly digested his surprise. At those same words, Cecilus’s eyes widened, before a familiar smile broke across his face and said,

Cecilus: [―― Perfect !!]

△▼△▼△▼△

He had continued to fool, fabricate, lie, trick, ensnare, entrap, and deceive and deceive and deceive.

He did not like to deceive. However, it was his expertise.

It was an accident that Noh had come to dwell within Chisha Gold, but when he thought of the results it had brought about, he could not help but feel it was inevitable ――no, that it was “foreshadowing”.

Was it perhaps a bit too narrative brained to believe so?

Chisha: [However, it cannot be helped. How long have I spent alongside Cecilus, and been exposed to that cheerful and endless flood of words?]

Even if he did not empathize with that point of view, there were many ways in which it had influenced him.

Nothing, not even all of Cecilus’s views, could be simply dismissed as absurd. Surprisingly, Cecilus’s words were not void of any deeper meaning.

In particular, he understood the idea Cecilus espoused that everyone was an actor, and had their part to play upon the stage. ――If so, then what was the role of Chisha Gold?

???: [Contrary to my expectations, I do not feel any strong emotions. ――Even as I look up from below like this at the throne I was driven from.]

Chisha: [――――]

Chisha narrowed his golden eyes, and as he received the man who had arrived from upon the throne, that man brazenly strode across the red carpet spread out before him, as if it was his own.

The man who appeared was beautiful, with black hair, and wore a mask that was modeled after an Oni. Ironically enough, the one he faced was Chisha, whose occupation was wearing “masks”, and this man was the leader of the rebels who drew near to the Imperial Capital―― no, he was the one and only true Emperor of the Sacred Vollachian Empire, Vincent Vollachia.

Vincent: [――Did you realize your desires by joining forces with Berstetz and exiling me?]

While overcoming much and suffering numerous trials, Vincent had returned to his own castle.

He was by no means outstanding physically, he had no one to rely upon in his position of being ousted from the throne, and truly his only weapons should have been his own ingenuity and the power of his words; it was the triumphant return of such an Emperor.

The peak of the Empire, Chisha Gold’s lord, asked if his desires had been realized.

Chisha: [Unfortunately, I regrettably must say that they have not been realized yet. Therefore, I would like to ask for Your Excellency’s cooperation for just a little while longer.]

Vincent: [You have taken this much, yet you still desire something more from me? You have an even greedier side of you than I thought. ――However, ‘tis a deception.]

Chisha: [――――]

Vincent: [What you thought you would get from removing me from the throne was no more than insubstantial mist. The fires of war have spread pointlessly, and these needless flames continue to consume the Empire. ――There is a way to extinguish it all immediately.]

As he said this, Vincent brought his hands to his face, and removed the oni mask.

His true face laid bare in this way, which Chisha could no longer even meet in a mirror, having lost that “mask”, was undoubtedly that of his lord’s. It was probably due to the fair amount of hardship he had accumulated, but compared to when he was on the throne, his complexion was a little paler, his cheeks were thinner, and the bones more prominent.

Still, when comparing his fatigue between when he was working hard as the Emperor and his days of running around trying to reclaim his throne, it was apparent that Vincent had been neglecting himself too much.

――Yes, His Excellency, the Emperor had been neglecting himself too much.

Vincent: [I――]

Chisha: [――Your Excellency.]

He interrupted as Vincent tried to continue, and Chisha called out his lord’s title.

In that moment, despite not closing his eyes, the faces of a great many people flashed by in his mind’s eye. Everything he had erred in, the feelings of guilt in his heart for having deceived all of them; Chisha let out a breath, and,

Chisha: [――Taking too much of a grand view of the game board, that is your greatest weakness.]

In an instant, Chisha brought his hand from behind his back to cover his face, putting on a “mask”. With a creaking sound, Chisha’s body was transformed, his height shrunk, his sinewy physique deformed, and his chest swelled. And so, his trump card manifested before Vincent――,

Chisha: [――Mask of the Sun.]

Prisca Benedict.

In those days, she was called by that name, but the person who was now a candidate in the Royal Section of the neighboring country of Lugunica had another name; wearing the “mask” of Vincent Vollachia’s greatest weakness, Chisha laughed.

Kicking off the floor, Chisha leapt at Vincent, who was left speechless by this inconceivable reunion. As if he was dancing unburdened, Chisha reached out toward the frozen Vincent’s face, and――,

Chisha: [――Mask of the Wise Emperor]

Swiftly, he molded a new “mask” of Vincent with Noh, then casted off the “mask” of Prisca he had only just put on, donning the new mask.

As the sound of his substitution rang out once more, Chisha took further action against the frozen Vincent, while enduring his transforming body.

He snatched the oni mask Vincent had removed, and concealed the Emperor’s true face with it once again.

Vincent: [You――]

For what, for whom, why?

The voice of the Emperor who was too wise trembled as if seeking an answer to the events that had occurred. However, without Chisha’s words, the Emperor surely could not reach that answer.

It was just as he had informed Vincent a moment ago.

He looked at the board from a grand perspective, thought through things efficiently, and indiscriminately defined the value of every piece.

The true intentions behind Chisha’s actions would likely never be conveyed to Vincent, who lacked the awareness that he himself was also an actor upon the stage.

But that was fine. It did not matter whether his true intentions were conveyed.

What he desired, was the outcome.

Would that outcome be that Chesha Trim, a being that had an inconsequential minor role, put on the “mask” of Chisha Gold, and thus deceived even everything he had gained to get what he desired?

He could not confirm it himself, but he was sure.

If he could fool the Observers, ensnare the Great Disaster, and even deceive Vincent Vollachia to the very end, then what Chisha desired would surely shine through.

Therefore――,

Vincent: [――――]

As he was pushed away, Chisha could faintly make out through the oni mask that his cheeks stiffened.

It was a look that many would undoubtedly mistake the true meaning of. The Emperor, who was too wise, and thus often omitted words that should not be omitted, was laconic even with that expression.

He suspected that he was probably the only one who could correctly interpret the meaning of that expression, given his many years alongside the Emperor.

Chisha: [Ahh, and yet――]

By some chance, maybe, perhaps, he had held some expectation.

That maybe there was someone who could look head-on at this Vincent Vollachia, a magnificently wise Emperor, and an all too foolish and self-deprecating man.

He could not help but think so.

Chisha: [――――]

When light broke through the castle wall, missed the form of Vincent as he was pushed away, and pierced Chisha’s chest as he wore the “mask” of the Emperor, he saw it outside the window.

――An accomplice who should have been far away, was riding a flying dragon and flew toward this place.

None may live, having had their hearts pierced.

Consequently, that was an event inevitable, the terminus of fate as was bound to arrive.

Chisha: [――――]

The man had died.

He was Chesha Trim, became Chisha Gold, and finally as Vincent Vollachia, the man had died.

Before the lord he had devoted his loyalty to, and the accomplice who had assisted him in deceiving that lord, he had died.

――And that was the entirety of what had transpired, in that moment.

△▼△▼△▼△

――And so, the story has converged to the form it should have originally taken, and the time of the Great Disaster has come.

The hordes of the resurrected dead, commanded by the Witch desiring the destruction of the Empire, shall set the world ablaze.

Despite the gathered Nine Divine Generals joining different camps than they should have, or even having the conclusion of their whole lives changed, to exhibit their greatest valor, they shall set their lives ablaze.

The girls crossing into a neighboring country to search for the cherished boy they were separated from shall witness a heroic turning point that will arrive in the Empire, and without losing hope in the midst of it all, shall set their bonds ablaze.

And the woman like the sun, possessing one half of the two Yang Swords which should have never existed, in order to respond to the horde of the dead whose existence has been twisted and the Witch baring her rage toward her, she shall shine with her unchanging arrogant beauty and set her soul ablaze.

At the core of this story painted with flames and flames and flames, those who witnessed the death of the man who deceived all until the end, with their voices hoarse, tears of blood shed, and souls cracked, they shall set fate ablaze.

???: [――Stand! Don’t give up! Giving up is the one thing I will never allow! You should have known a long time ago why that guy lied to you!!]

???: [Silence, foolish commoner. What in the world can you say about me? I am――]

???: [You are!!]

Both: [The 77th Emperor of the Sacred Vollachian Empire, Vincent Vollachia.]

With trembling knees about to buckle, the man rose.

Desperately keeping his sobbing heart in check, the boy clenched his fists.

A young girl, blaming herself for her lack of power, told herself there is still more she can do and raised her head, while a child grabbing onto her pointed toward the Great Disaster shaking the Empire and howled.

There was a large hole in the castle walls, and looking down from there, two men lined up.

Side by side, their gazes met, Natsuki Subaru and Vincent Vollachia, two people who joined together with the karma that they should have met far sooner, two people entrusted with this by the man who deceived fate until the end, they shall destroy the advancing Great Disaster, and to seize the future that man desired, they shall face forward.

Vincent: [I am your Emperor, Vincent Vollachia. ――One of the Sword Wolves of the Empire.]

Subaru: [My name is Natsuki Subaru, just a passerby shaking the realm like roaring thunder, but I am the accomplice of the great liar, Chisha Gold!]

The two of them declared their positions, the air of the Imperial Capital resounded with loud and strong voices.

Natsuki Subaru grimaced as he relayed how they had assembled the game board so that the greatest amount of military power would be concentrated in the Imperial Capital when the coming Great Disaster and terrifying hordes of enemies descended upon them.

And then――,

Subaru: [I took the baton you passed me against my will. ――Bring it on, O inevitable fate!!]

△▼△▼△▼△

――It was probably an instance where a single misstep sent the entire journey astray.

With but a single misalignment of gears, the tale twisted askew, and the rails of fate changed course with ease.

When the expected flow of events shifted, the torrent of destiny tossed people around like leaves from a tree.

And yet.

And yet, what if they still finally found their way unto that changeless shore on the other side, unyielding?

Surely, it was only when a strong, unwavering desire utterly deceived that Commandment.

It was precisely within that once-in-a-lifetime lie that the meaning of that man’s life dwelled――,

Chisha: [――If this is my one and only chance for a starring performance, then I shall close the curtains like so.]

Fin.

With that, that was our annual April Fool’s Day project!

He was a man who had little time on stage in the main story, and only revealed his true intentions at the very end.

He was a character who had nothing revealed except the important parts since he had almost no contact with Subaru. However, if they were to encounter each other in an alternate timeline ――This became the seventh chapter of IF.

In this timeline, the characters involved here and there are different, the development of events Subaru follows changes, and there are individuals he can be deeply involved with and those he can’t, overall it is quite interesting. And yet, in either route, Subaru cross-dresses. It is his fate.

Anyways, thank you for joining me again this year!

I’m glad, since I only wanted to do this on April Fool’s Day, after the Empire arc was done.

How much do the positions of the characters or who survives change between the main story and Azamuku? I think I will bring up these matters again at another time, perhaps in an activity report!

Well, thanks! Have good dreams!

Translation Notes:

[1] – A gag from a classic manga by Osamu Tezuka called Black Jack. A character called Pinoko would make a face where both hands were squishing her cheeks while saying “Acchonburike!” when surprised.

[2] – Chisha’s power, Noh (『能』), literally means talent or ability, but is a reference to Noh theater, written with the same kanji. See here for more information on it: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Noh

[3] – Subaru does not seem to recognize the word 大災 (Great Disaster) at first, since it is a rare term. He repeats the word in katakana (タイサイ), which indicates he is likely sounding it out before then realizing what it means. One potentially funny interpretation is that he may have initially thought Chisha said bok choy, since one term for bok choy in Japanese is a homophone.

[4] – A zori is a traditional Japanese sandal.
