As she narrowed her amethyst eyes, Emilia tried to continue her words from before. He’d want to immediately interrupt if there was something he didn’t want to hear, but that was difficult. Not lending his ears to this Emilia’s words was more difficult than cutting off the words of God.

However――,

Subaru:「Whoops.」

Even if it was impossible to spontaneously interrupt her, he could still interrupt her due to external factors. Suddenly hearing a noise drawing closer from behind him, Subaru shifted his attention away from Emilia and made his way to the side of the main road. The sound of wheels drawing closer informed him that a dragon carriage was approaching.

At once, he pulled Shaula’s arm and the two of them escaped from the path of the dragon carriage.

Shaula:「Yhaa, Master sure is aggressive…」

Subaru:「Get off.」

Subaru boisterously avoided Shaula’s hug who had been taking advantage of him having pulled her arm. Having been shook off, Shaula crashed against some trees along the main road, and she let out a shriek,「GYAAAA!」

Giving a quick glance back at Shaula whose nose had turned red, still crashing against trees, Subaru waited for the dragon carriage to pass by and out of his sight, before going back onto the main road once again――,

???:「Hmm?」

Ahead of him, the dragon carriage that had passed by Subaru and Shaula let out a sound and came to a halt. It didn’t seem like it was due to any troubles with the carriage body. With that, he couldn’t think of any reason for it coming to a stop other than because of Subaru and Shaula.

It was still the peak time of the day, but the road was deserted. Subaru increased his vigilance for a split second as if he’d come across bandits or the likes.

???:「――You wouldn’t happen to be Natsuki Subaru-san by any chance?」

However, that vigilance quickly vanished too due to the call from the individual who had descended from the dragon carriage’s driver seat. After calling out his name, the tall youth who should have been sat at the driver’s seat of the dragon carriage walked over to Subaru, who had now let go of his vigilance.

It was an individual whose age was around about Subaru’s, with grey hair that was tied up into a ponytail. Though his gentle features didn’t give off any striking impressions, quite unexpectedly, his build was quite robust. He didn’t give off the vibes that he performed manual labor, but it did look like his work involved some at least.

Regardless of such a first impression, what mattered the most for Subaru was that this youth recognized him, and that he had called out his name.

???:「Ahh, it’s as I thought, it’s Natsuki-san isn’t it? It’s been a long time.」

Subaru:「Aaah, well…」

He was a youth that greeted out to him with the familiarity of no doubt an acquaintance, even though there was a bit of a distance. As he hesitated on deciding how he would respond to him, Subaru looked around to his surroundings.

Receiving that look, Emilia, Beatrice and the others shook their heads. They had indicated that they had no clue who he was to Subaru. Emilia and the others, and Subaru as well, had thrown their hands up at that, but he hesitated in starting a conversation whilst pretending to know him.

That was Subaru’s signature move, but he didn’t want to do it right now due to various reasons. Seeing Subaru embroiled in confusion within his current mental state, the youth furrowed his well-shaped eyebrows and said,

???:「Oh, perhaps you’ve forgotten? It’s me, Regin Suwen… My older brother, Otto Suwen, helps you out. We met once before at the village.」

Subaru:「Regin you say… Ah, that Otto’s!」

Regin:「When you say it like that Otto , it’s almost like you’re saying it like it’s someone else’s business, no?」

Showing a forced smile at that unnatural expression, Subaru clapped his hands together in comprehension in front of the youth―― Regin. Unfortunately, he couldn’t remember Regin’s figure, but he did know Otto’s.

Now that it was mentioned, Regin and Otto’s features did have many similarities with each other. There wasn’t any doubts that they were brothers, and also acquaintances of Subaru.

Subaru:「It was my bad, it was my bad. Like you just caught me now at a time where various things are going on inside my head. That’s why your name didn’t come to me right away, or something like that.」

Regin:「Nono, I guess it couldn’t be helped since you’re in such a busy position. The royal selection has reached even my ears living in the remote countryside… Nii-san isn’t causing you any nuisances, right?」

Emilia:『Otto-kun causing you nuisances… what a preposterous thing to say, eh? Everyone of us has been helped out in various ways thanks to Otto-kun.』

Subaru:「Yeah. Otto’s become a great help to all of us in the camp… something like that. If that guy wasn’t there, it’d seem like things would be far more all over the place.」

Regin:「Is that… so? I guess that’s good then…」

Though Regin expressed a vague sense of gratitude as he said that, it seemed that he was quite relieved to be told about the current state of his older brother. And after that, he flitted between looking at Subaru and Shaula who were standing a short distance away from each other.

Regin:「Even so, Natsuki-san, what are you doing in a place like this? I would think it’d be quite arduous walking on the main road without even riding on a dragon carriage…」

Subaru:「Aah, you’re quite right there, or rather, how should I put it… I’d love to make use of a dragon carriage, or the likes if possible, but due a number of reasons doing that would be difficult. And, regarding what you said before about what I’m doing…」

Cutting his words off there, Subaru thought for a second. And then, he found the right words.

Subaru:「The current me is in the middle of reconsidering my own self… you could say『A Journey of Self-Discovery』.」

Regin:「A Journey of Self-Discovery…?」

Subaru「Mhhhm, that’s right. A Journey of Self-Discovery… Gh-hahahaha!」

His own words were amusing; Subaru laughed involuntarily. Although “Self-Discovery” was a word which was common with young people, were there any other relevant words which fit this well with the current Subaru? If he thought about it, it wasn’t so amusing.

Regin seemed to have vaguely felt that something was out of place at the state Subaru was in, and he said「Are you all right?」with a manner of concern for Subaru.

Regin:「Is something in your body not quite well? For a second, I was certain that this was the reason behind Natsuki-san recognizing me so late, but since I’ve been mistaken for others often before…」

Subaru:「My body isn’t unwell, really. If you’re talking about how I feel emotionally, then I’m on the confines of the worst I guess. But, it’s thanks to you, Regin, that I’ll hang in there. I was relieved to meet you here you know.」

Interrupting Regin’s words, Subaru deeply bowed his head and expressed his gratitude. Seeing Subaru’s attitude, Regin continued to get more and more bewildered. However, it seemed like he had furthered his conviction that Subaru’s attitude before his eyes was quite abnormal. Regin made a resolute facial expression, and called out to Subaru with a「Natsuki-san,」

Regin:「I don’t really get the situation well, but for the time being, please come to the village with me. Let’s talk about it in detail at my clinic. You need to rest.」

Subaru:「Are you speaking like a doctor?」

Regin:「Though my patients are earth dragons, livestock and the likes, I am a doctor. Have you forgotten that too?」

Subaru:「――Forgotten. Aaah, that’s right. I’ve… forgotten?」

Regin:「Natsuki-san?」

If only he had forgotten, then for Natsuki Subaru, things likely would have ended up without him tasting the feelings of isolation that he had felt up until now. However, those feelings that tormented Natsuki Subaru were not easy things to forget.

Subaru:「Your village is further ahead, right? Have I ever stopped by?」

Regin:「Y-yeah, of course. In the past, when there was a bit of an issue, you, my older brother and that other guy came together…」

Subaru:「――I see. Thank you.」

He had been able to roughly hear what he wanted. He turned to face Regin, who had been daunted by Subaru’s words, and continued.

Subaru:「The way you… and your older brother talk are very similar.」

Regin:「Huh?」

Subaru:「You are quite the good guy. Your brother seems to be a good guy too.」

That’s why from hereafter, their『First Reunion』would also be terrible. By no means was it something that he’d derive pleasure from or look forward to.

Subaru:「――Shaula.」

Shaula:「Present; what’s up Master?」

Subaru:「Don’t hurt him.」

It was a short, nondescript call. But, by simply guessing his intentions, Shaula nodded with a「Arahorasassā!」 (TL Note: this is a reference to Yatterman (A Japanese anime, which also got a film), where from some research the trio from the animated film says アラホラサッサー！in one of their songs. I’m going to leave this untranslated. But it’s something like Hey, hey, hey.)

And――,

Subaru:「I’m sorry.」

Subaru apologized to Regin who was in front of him with a single phrase. The true meaning of his apology this time was far more clear than the vagueness of the one from some time before. However, Regin never understood the real meaning.

――That was because before Regin could understand, his head had been engulfed by light and had evaporated.

Subaru:「――――」

Regin’s headless body collapsed onto the main road without him even letting out a cry of pain. An intense heat burned the wound, and even blood couldn’t flow from the cross section of his neck.

Although it was ethically a mistake to praise how the murder had been carried out so skillfully, it was a blow that was so refined that he wanted to reflexively appraise it.

Subaru:「It’s a thing of splendor no matter how many times I see it.」

Shaula:「It’s the technique that I perfected sniping the Witch Beasts from the top of the tower that approached day in and day out, without having anything else to do for 400 years. Now that I think back on it, those are grey days unfitting for a maiden of age, right?」

Subaru:「You’ve lived for 400 years and you call yourself a maiden of age…?」

Without any emotion at the tragedy before his eyes, Subaru tilted his head at Shaula’s words. And then, dragging Regin’s headless corpse along, he approached his dragon carriage, that had lost its owner.

However, when the earth dragon noticed the approaching Subaru and the others, it immediately started to run away, trying to leave Subaru and others behind on the main road.

In an instant, a white light shot past Subaru’s side and pierced through the dragon carriage’s wagon. The attack penetrated into the earth dragon’s flesh as it still pulled the dragon carriage along, burning its insides, piercing through its head and finally snatching away its life.

Though it was a rather skillful blow, it was an unwanted one.

Subaru:「…HEEEY!」

Shaula:「Th-there weren’t any hard feelings! It was legitimate self-defense! It’s the result of having braced my legs trying to stop it in my own way! It’s just that my killing machine habits don’t go away so easily!」

Subaru:「I’m not angry. I’m not angry, but we may not be able to get ahold of a dragon carriage again now. When are we going to upgrade from travelling on foot…」

He had no luck at all with earth dragons when he brought Shaula along like this. Thanks to her accompanying him, it’d already been determined that Subaru would be forced to keep walking on foot forevermore.

Shaula:「S―o, isn’t it as I always say? Even if it’s not an emergency, when it’s Master, I will always carry you on my back~ And when I do, I won’t even mind if you carelessly fondle anything strange! How’s that!?」

Subaru:「It sounds like you’re gonna ask for money after or something.」

Evading Shaula’s temptation with his blunt words, Subaru pulled Regin’s corpse into the forcibly stopped dragon carriage. The large body of the earth dragon had also fallen onto the main road having received the same fate as its owner, all the way to the point of having lost its head. Of course, the earth dragon couldn’t be taken away with Subaru’s strength. But.

Subaru:「For now, go drag the earth dragon along with the dragon carriage to the forest’s vicinity. I will try go to the village that Regin spoke of. ――Do you get where I’ll be?」

Shaula:「It’s a piece of cake. I should try to make it so they aren’t found, right?」

Subaru:「If they can’t be found for a short while, that’s fine. It’s enough if they can be left hidden for 2 or 3 days.」

Getting off from the dragon carriage, he instructed Shaula to conceal the tragedy that had happened. Raising her hand in a salute of acceptance, Shaula grabbed ahold of the huge body of the earth dragon and easily lifted up its corpse in her slender arms. The dragon carriage also began to be pulled.

Whilst she went to hide the dragon carriage in the forest, Subaru turned to look towards where the village was.

Subaru:「Now then.」

Subaru started to walk, not without purpose, but with a set goal in mind. He walked straight towards the village Regin should have returned to.

How many people knew『Natsuki Subaru』 in that village?

Either too few or too many, whichever it was, it made him feel heavy in heart. But, although it was true that it was a matter of unpleasantness, were he to avoid it then he wouldn’t be able to pick the right path.

It was a heartless choice, but it was one he had no choice but to do.

If. ――If I can at least get back 『 Natsuki Subaru 』, everything will be alright.

Subaru:「Will getting him back even be effective?」

It’s for that reason that Subaru made the choices『Natsuki Subaru』couldn’t take.

※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※

Subaru:「――Hk, hhaa.」

Subaru let the book that he had grasped in both hands drop the instant his consciousness spiralled back to reality.

His knees trembled, and his breaths had become ragged. An unbearable sense of dizziness, like the sort you’d get from standing up too fast, overwhelmed him despite him sitting on the ground.

――It felt like he’d never get used to it no matter how many times he experienced it.

Subaru:「Hhaa, hhaa……」

Brusquely wiping away the cold sweat dripping down his forehead with his sleeve, Subaru kept taking deep breaths and calmed his heartbeat down. Was the cause of his irregular heartbeat the chaos that came from the dissonance between his soul and body?

Each time he tackled a book, one after the other, he’d find that within the book, the thing he called 『Himself』had become hazier.

A sane human being probably wouldn’t be able to know the boundaries between themselves and others if this kept being repeated, and they’d melt together. Or rather, they’d probably lose sight of their very self.

Shaula:「Master, are you alright?」

Subaru:「…Yeah, I’m okay, I’m fine. More importantly, have you found the next book?」

Shaula:「Lemme see… I’m still looking. It’s like matching pictures, they’re difficult to find~. I’m really not cut out for this kind of menial work…」

Voicing out her concerns for the roughly breathing Subaru, Shaula crossed her fingers at her own disappointing lack of progress. However, Subaru had no intentions of blaming such a fragile girl.

That was because he was making her help with something unsuited for her, just like she herself was aware of. On top of that, there were bounds even to his inhumanity in going as far to rebuke the girl who’d been doing his bidding without getting anything in return.

What she did, was more than enough. There was a line that should be drawn even for Subaru, who kept running on the path of inhumanity.

Subaru:「I know that you’re not cut out for this, but I’m counting on you Shaula. There’s no one else who can lend me their strength besides you.」

Shaula:「It’d be nice Master, if you could say it as… just me.」

Subaru:「…Right now, the one I’m counting on, is just you.」

Shaula:「Hehe, now that makes me satisfied.」

Puffing out her cheeks, Shaula once again dove back into the sea of books with a satisfied expression on her face. Although presumably she wouldn’t hold onto that good mood for very long, her eyes were indispensable for finding the books.

Her presence was a matter of life or death for Subaru, even insofar to the meaning of her being simple manpower.

Subaru:「――――」

Subaru picked up the book that had dropped to his feet that he had been reading before, and ran his finger across the title written on its spine.

The title of the black book was plain and simple;『Regin Suwen』was written there.

That youth, who had happened to meet『Natsuki Subaru』in the past, had unluckily lost his life by meeting the current Natsuki Subaru―― Subaru had experienced his life in the book as if he were him.

The memories of his chance meeting with『Natsuki Subaru』had also certainly been there within that vicarious experience. But.

Subaru:「…They weren’t that well acquainted. From Regin’s perspective,『Natsuki Subaru』was a guy that came along with his older brother and it seems he didn’t know him well.」

Perusing the memories that had become part of himself, Subaru sighed, feeling as if he had wasted effort. In all honesty, he did think that the one who most wanted to sigh was Regin who’d ended up as the victim in this. However his disappointment amidst his feelings of wasted effort were also something that he couldn’t avoid.

Regin:『Hey, no matter how much you look at it, things aren’t like that, wouldn’t you think so, Natsuki-san?』

Subaru:「…Sorry. Even though I’ve snatched away all of your memories, the relationship is still far too thin, and reproducing it has become lower. It doesn’t seem like there are going to be many chances where I am going to pay attention to you.」

Staring reproachfully at the book with his own name written on it, between the bookshelves, Regin gave Subaru a rather profound look. Although it was to be expected, a hint of blame lay thick within his eyes.

After all, just about anyone would be in an awful mood if their death was lambasted as having been useless after being killed.

Being aware of that, Subaru gave him an honest apology and said “Sorry.” However――,

Regin:『Either way, I’ve got no choice but to accept that I’ve died. Besides, if your objectives are fulfilled, Natsuki-san, then everything will go back to how it was, right? Let’s hope for that.』

Subaru:「Ooh, you have the tolerance of a saint. I’m sorry to be taking advantage of your generosity, but I’m depending on it. I will pay back this debt when I put things back exactly to how they were.」

Regin:『Then let’s not hope for it, instead, let’s await it.』

Shrugging his shoulders, Regin waved and then started to fade from Subaru’s sight like mist. After he watched him disappear, Subaru put Regin’s『Book of the Dead』back on its shelf. And then, he picked up a paper that was nearby and crossed something out with his quill. ――The paper was a register which had a lot of names written on it. And just now, he had drawn a horizontal line where Regin’s name was.

Subaru:「…And that makes 23.」

As he counted the numbers he had squiggled out, Subaru cracked the bones in his neck, knowing he had a long way to go.

The library which had the『Books of the Dead』on show――『Taygeta’s』hostility was still going strong. And no matter how many times he’d visited it, it wouldn’t give Subaru a in-library search feature or the like.

Since he used it so frequently, he thought it wouldn’t really hurt if the service improved even a little bit. But, it sure was really annoying.

Beatrice:『Betty’s forbidden library was quite big too, but it’s not at all comparable to this one, I suppose. No one ought to complain about that again, in fact, Subaru.』

Julius『I agree. It looks nearly impossible to find a specific book in such an enormous library. You have to sit yourself down and deliberately apply yourself to the task. You’ll just keep exhausting yourself if you keep on going in blindly.』

Just as the complaints had crossed through his mind, Beatrice and Julius had given him their suggestions as they looked around the library. Their words were kind to Subaru, but that was why he stubbornly shook his head.

Of course, if he chose to devote time to it as had been suggested to him, then perhaps his feelings of wasted effort and anxiety would be eased just a little, but――

Subaru:「Trying to ease them would be a luxury in the first place. I don’t have any free time to sit around doing nothing. I have to reach a solution as soon as I can…」

Ram:『What if you don’t reach it? Will something change if Barusu hurries up a little?』

Subaru:「It’ll change! ――Everything will change!」

Ram glared at Subaru as he declared that with clenched fists, with her cold, pale crimson eyes. Turning away from her gaze, Subaru stared down at the list of names he held within his hand.

The list had all of the names of each person from the same village as Regin written down. Judging from what he consulted from Regin’s memories, the likelihood that they’d be helpful in getting anything conclusive was quite low. Low, but not zero.

Then, if that was the case――

Emilia:『Will what Subaru wants to do come true if you read the books of those people?』

Subaru:「Emilia-tan…」

Subaru hesitated for a split second at Emilia’s question, worry adorning her eyes. But, Subaru nodded at Emilia like he was saying it to himself above anything else.

Subaru:「Of course it will. Ever since… Ever since I forgot everything, I’ve just been causing everyone unimaginable trouble. This is the only way I can get everything back.」

Emilia:『I didn’t even consider that…』

Subaru:「――That’s not good enough!」

Emilia’s expression grew gloomier as if she were unable to bear to look at the angered Subaru. Subaru had raised his voice at her without meaning to.

And as he stared straight at the shocked Emilia’s eyes, Subaru continued to speak.

Subaru:「For crying out loud, please don’t say that. No matter what it takes… I will try and get『Natsuki Subaru』back. And after that…」

Emilia:『…And after that?』

Subaru:「And after that I’ll meet you all once again… I’ll meet you all and start anew.」 It was after losing everything, that he realized everything was important, far too late. Why didn’t people realize that what they had in their hands was irreplaceable until the load they carried on their back got lighter?

Unless losing everything and recovering didn’t go hand in hand, then why――,

Emilia:『――――』

Emilia stared at Subaru with somewhat feeble eyes, as Subaru forced those words out into a mutter. Complex emotions filled those amethyst eyes which even Subaru couldn’t read.

He should have been able to clearly see everything about her. And yet, his anxiety would be cruelly stirred up in the instances where he didn’t understand what lay in her heart.

What did Emilia think? What did Emilia feel? And how did she receive the current Subaru?

Those answer were――

Shaula:「――Master! I found the next book! Praise me Praise me!」

Subaru:「Ah, aaah, well done. You did great, Shaula.」

Shaula:「Huhehehehehe~」

Shaula, who had come jumping in, had forced his dialogue with Emilia to come to an end. Subaru gave Shaula a head-pat; as a result, her face relaxed and she gratefully accepted it.

The book she held in her hand definitely matched the name written on his list.

Subaru:「…How long has『Natsuki Subaru』been sleeping inside you?」

Receiving the book from Shaula, Subaru posed this question at the book that couldn’t answer him back.

Even though it was to be expected, the books didn’t concisely answer Subaru’s questions. However, answers did indeed lie within the books. All of his barbaric acts were necessary sacrifices for this purpose.

Subaru:「Fragmented, objective information is good enough. I’ll scrape it all up, and bring it closer to its completed form…」

Evaluation was something that was assessed and decided by the measure of others.

If that was the case, then if he were able to check everyone’s assessment and if the individual that was being assessed could be checked by the measure of everyone, then he should be able to reconstruct that person.

――And recover『Natsuki Subaru』.

That was Natsuki Subaru’s highest priority; his entire journey had been for this purpose.

Of course, all of the sacrifices that had been made, along with all the sacrifices which would be made in the future, were all necessary actions so that Natsuki Subaru could get『Natsuki Subaru』back.

If he could get『Natsuki Subaru』back. If he at least came back.

Subaru:「…If it’s you, I know you would take care of everything possible.」

The memories of Emilia, Beatrice, Ram, Meili, Julius, individuals other than them and in general, all the individuals who had some relation to him. He desired memories like those.

Because, that strength should be in『Natsuki Subaru.』

Because, with that strength――,

Subaru:「――Save me.」

I’m counting on you, 『 Natsuki Subaru .』 If you’re a hero, then save me.

Patching together, patching together, continuing to form its shape.

Patching together, patching together, continuing to mold its shape.

Patching together, patching together, continuing to fill in the colors.

Patching together, patching together, patching together, and continuing towards bringing himself closer to completion.

※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※

――『Murder becomes a habit.』

That was one of the phrases the famous detective, Hercule Poirot, left the world with.

The meaning of this phrase didn’t refer to a person who had killed a human being and then suddenly woke up with a preference for murdering people, who then kept repeating the crime to satisfy their cravings.

It referred to someone who once solved their problems by murder, and for them, whenever another problem arose, they would think about trying to break through the problem through murder again.

――『Murder becomes a habit.』

But, if killing really was linked to the solution of the problem, could it even be said that it was the result of murder becoming a habit?

Couldn’t it be said that it wasn’t that murder became a habit, but rather that unavoidable circumstances sprang forth.

The situation wasn’t that of adding murder as an option because it had become a habit, but rather such that there was no option other than to murder. Perhaps saying things like murder had become a habit wasn’t possible anymore.

――『Murder becomes.』

To hell with Hercule Poirot. Fictional detectives needn’t talk so pretentiously.

How could he have said it as if he saw through everything!? The reasons behind every situation, behind everything, are tangled together in various complications, with multiple layers of complexity to them.

Don’t disregard those things and make light of them by trying to apply those words to everything.

――『Murder.』

This was the only way when there was no other. It was the most logical when there was no other way to reach the correct answer.

That’s why it wasn’t murder becomes a habit, but rather…

――『Only murder becomes the answer.』

Yeah, that’s right. Of course it was. Only that was the answer. Only that was the correct answer. Only that would cut through the hopelessness of this dead-end; it was a last resort.

Emilia:『Subaru is always helping me out; you’ll end up finding a solution no matter what… My esteemed knight.』

Beatrice:『If Subaru hadn’t been there, Betty would still be completely alone in the forbidden library, I suppose.』

Ram:『Ah well… Barusu is a man with good timing. Even Ram will admit that much.』

Meili:『If Onii-san wasn’t so anno~ying, then I’m sure he wouldn’t have messed up his wo~rk.』

Julius:『Subaru, though perhaps you aren’t aware of it, but I was also saved by you. Your being was a path of hope for me as well.』

Subaru:「I know.」

I know that you all love『Natsuki Subaru』a lot.

I know that you all really care about『Natsuki Subaru.』

I know that the『Natsuki Subaru』that saved you all is a Superman.

I’m aware that everything that the『Natsuki Subaru』that saved you all did has been ruined.

That’s why I have to get him back.

If I can at least get him, if I can at least get『Natsuki Subaru』back.

If I can at least do that, everything will turn out well. It’ll all turn out well.

I have to keep going.

???:「――Natsuki Subaru has gone mad, and has killed Emilia, Julius and everyone else who accompanied him. I barely escaped with my life and somehow managed to run away and make it here.」

Everyone gathered frowned as they received the report Anastasia had brought back. The meaning behind what was shown on their faces was quite clear.

“Anastasia”:「It’s natural that all of you would judge this as hard to believe. I also deeply regret that I had to bring back this report. But, if we take into account the danger he poses, we cannot afford to look away from reality.」

???:「Anastasia-sama, even if you’re saying that, I don’t thi…」

Echidna:「――I am Echidna. Ana is still sleeping inside this body even now. Though, perhaps staying like this may be a blessing for her.」

???:「…It sounds like such a far-fetched story.」

The one who had cast his eyes down and then replied as he stood in front of Anastasia―― No, Echidna, was a red-haired knight; it was Reinhard van Astrea.

They were in the Watergate City Pristella―― Those that had gathered there were those who were involved in the Royal Selection. The battle for the city had ended quite some time ago, and each one present was awaiting the report regarding the return of Subaru and the others who had headed to the east.

Emilia and the others had headed to the east to borrow the『Sage’s』wisdom to find a means of restoring the calamitous damage the Witch Cult had caused as a result of the Sin Archbishops having appeared in Pristella.

They were embroiled in anxiety. But, they were awaiting good news.

The grounds to make them believe that lay in one of the members that headed to the east. Those grounds were in none other than Natsuki Subaru himself. ――That would show how he had gone mad, amongst other things.

The one whom he had made the promise with wasn’t there anymore, let alone the vestiges of the promise he had shared.

Subaru had no choice but to build『Natsuki Subaru』up little by little by collecting all the scraps of『Natsuki Subaru』from every single people who knew『Natsuki Subaru』and patching them into his original form.

In its completed form, it would contain all the memories of those who were familiar with『Natsuki Subaru』. Like Emilia, Beatrice, and so on; Shaula was no exception either.

That’s why he had promised Reinhard that he’d kill him someday as well.

She kept openly smiling in front of Subaru’s eyes. She kept helping Subaru in his objective without any hesitation. She kept interacting with her carefree attitude. And he had to kill her.

Subaru:「And yet, you accompany me? Shaula?」

Shaula:「Are you worried about meeee? Is it because you love me?」

Subaru:「――. Don’t joke about. I’m asking you seriously.」

But, after receiving his words, Shaula called back to him with a:「Master.」

Shaula:「I’m really not joking about. Since being loved by Master is the meaning of my life. So, that’s what matters the moossst.」

Still in her usual tone, still with her clingy attitude which had to be bluntly brushed off, still giving off a rather flippant vibe where it couldn’t be distinguished if she was being serious or joking about, Shaula ran her hands down her ample breasts.

She ran them down and then turned her dark eyes to look at Subaru before giving him a weak smile.

What was shown there in her sincerity was an attitude that she lived her life earnestly, never ever lying. Shaula always spoke seriously. ――And since she did, she had no need to lie.

Shaula:「You may use meee as much as you like until I come to a miserable end. In exchange, I want you to love meee, and I want you to cry for meeee if I die. Since I’m really, I’m really just… I’m really just satisfied with that.」

Subaru:「…Why do you devote so much of yourself to me like that? It has to because I’m『Natsuki Subaru』.」

Shaula:「That’s not why.」

Subaru:「――――」

Shaula:「Master is Master; I don’t care about anything else. I just love wanting to love so that I want to love the one that I want to love. And, if that person loves me back, well, that’d be perfect. Am I speaking weirdly?」

Shaula tilted her head; it seemed like she didn’t hold a single doubt in what she’d said. Seeing that, Subaru let out a small「Hah.」 And soon enough what had been just a small snort of laughter steadily caused his throat to squeeze up into laughter.

Subaru laughed.

He didn’t laugh as either『Natsuki Subaru』or the play-acted version of『Natsuki Subaru』he put on in front of Emilia and the others. This time he laughed as the hollow Natsuki Subaru that had forgotten everything about his life in another world.

Subaru:「Ahhh, god damn, don’t you guys… don’t you people go fucking worrying about my damn self-discovery… Damn idiots.」

This is a just barely in-time update for the annual April Fool’s Day project!

――It was probably an instance where a single misstep sent the entire journey astray.

With but a single misalignment of gears, the tale twisted askew, and the rails of fate changed course with ease.

When the expected flow of events shifted, the torrent of destiny tossed people around like leaves from a tree.

And yet, what if they still finally found their way unto that changeless shore on the other side, unyielding?

Surely, it was only when a strong, unwavering desire utterly deceived that Commandment.

It was precisely within that once-in-a-lifetime lie that the meaning of that man’s life dwelled.

???: [Haa, haa… hk!]

The girl panted as she fled, desperately clutching the child’s hand.

Despite running with all her might, the girl’s speed was lacking. For, within this unfamiliar land, one of her legs was impaired. ――Nay, if one called it an unfamiliar land, then for this girl, the whole world was strange.

This was a place she did not recognize whatsoever, these circumstances were beyond her comprehension, and as for her current situation, she could fathom naught.

???: [Uu! Uu, aau!]

Dragged by the girl’s hand, the child, whose name she did not even know, had been continuously wailing inarticulate cries.

Girl: [――Hk.]

Tightly biting her lips, the girl banished the weakness within her mind and faced ahead.

Indeed, at this moment, everything was unknown to her.. However, certain truths were clear. She knew that she must not let go of this child’s hand, and that she must continue to run forward.

In the midst of this world awash with unknowns, the girl’s instinct cried out for her to flee. Escape was the sole means by which the girl could express her will to resist; a protest permitted to her present self.

Girl: [That, person… hk.]

Whilst experiencing a pain that seared her breath-starved lungs, the girl’s bewildered mind envisioned a single figure. It had the appearance of a boy with black hair and mean-looking eyes, and its very presence evoked both negative impulses as well as strange feelings――,

???: [―― Oh, it’s really an Oni. That’s unusual. ]

Girl: [――Hk.]

That carefree voice suddenly intruded on the girl’s thoughts, sending a tremor throughout her body, and she sharply whirled about.

Mirrored in the girl’s pale blue eyes was a one-eyed woman wearing an eyepatch who was running―― nay, flying beside her. She was a beautiful woman with the animal ears of a dogperson and much of her brown skin exposed to the wind. At the entrance of the woman cutting through the air with a long branch in her grasp, the child that was being dragged behind the girl let out a shriek.

The moment she heard that scream, the girl reflexively attempted to fend off the woman with her free hand.

However――,

Woman: [――? That didn’t connect. It’s a shame, but…]

Off-balance, her swung arm was seized effortlessly, and in turn, she found herself pulled in.

Their faces had drawn so near to one another that the tips of their noses were about to touch, and in the woman’s red eye uncovered by an eyepatch, the girl beheld her own visage in its reflection.

It was an unfamiliar face. ――That was the face of a girl who did not understand the world, let alone herself.

Woman: [I was told to capture you.]

Girl: [――Ah.]

The instant the girl beheld her reflection, the woman lightly tapped the center of her chest with a finger, and the girl felt a minute shock course throughout her entire body.

The action had effortlessly stolen the strength from the girl’s limbs, forcing her to collapse to her knees.

Girl: [Ugh!]

Woman: [That child, too.]

Beside the collapsed girl, the brave child leapt at the woman.

However, the woman caught the strike with the ease of twisting a baby’s hand, and then, that same shock the girl had endured was delivered to the child’s brow, and with an “Aauu?”, she flopped and toppled over as if all her strength had been sapped away.

As a result, the chase sequence starring the girl and the small child reached its anticlimactic conclusion.

Girl: [You, are…]

Woman: [Don’t worry, no harm will… well, I’m not sure. Sorry.]

As the girl crawled toward the dazed child, straining her voice, the woman offered words of apology. But, that was by no means a consolation, as there was no sense of being saved by that apology.

Whether she ought to deem it sincerity or clumsiness, the girl could choose neither.

Slowly but surely, as the child before her slipped into unconsciousness, so too did her own reality begin to fade away.

Woman: [Let’s go, Oni girl.]

Girl: [I, am…]

The sensation of being picked up by the woman was an action she could not resist. As her consciousness gradually faded to white, the girl’s lips trembled feebly.

Being called an Oni failed to resonate with her. That being said, there was another way she had been called――,

Rem: [――Rem.]

That name had been spoken by the black-haired boy enveloped in that dreadful, abhorrent stench.

Perhaps, it was some kind of illusion. ――That above all else, that name somehow felt familiar to her empty self that lacked anything.

――Things had taken a troublesome turn.

A combination of dread and vigilance coursed like lightning through Natsuki Subaru’s mind, compelling him to act urgently.

Why, why, why ; he had not even a moment to spare in order to ponder such a question.

He organized his thoughts concerning recent events: the arrival of the opportunity for a long-awaited reunion, and the bitter sorrow that came thereafter when reality had failed to meet his hopes. Suppressing that grief, focusing his mind on the precious people he had been separated from, he steeled his resolve to escape this irrational, senseless impasse―― at least, that was what he ought to do.

And yet――,

His back was pierced by the knifehand, and as he beheld his own heart torn from his chest, in a tempest of agony and shock, Subaru died instantly.

was a member of the Nine Divine Generals, an individual of the greatest military ability.

Standing his ground, Subaru pulled off the body of the girl―― Louis, who was clinging to his waist, then casually tossed her to one side. Spinning, Louis handled it with the nimbleness of a cat, then after making a face also like that of a stray cat, she returned to the side of the girl with open arms.

Receiving the return of Louis with a hug, Rem cast a reproachful gaze upon Subaru.

Rem: [How can you be so cold to such a small child. I can’t comprehend it.]

Subaru: [Rem, I’ve said it over and over, but that’s a bomb pretending to be a child. She’s being obedient now, but there’s no telling when she might explode. Please trust me on this…]

Rem: […When you stink so much? That’s impossible.]

Subaru: [――――]

Rem: [What’s with that moved look on your face?]

Subaru: [Nothing, just you telling me “You stink, you stink” is also nostalgic, so it just brought back some deeply moving feelings.]

Rem: [Ha?]

The reaction from Rem as she embraced Louis was cold, and overall, Subaru’s feelings were not taken very positively.

Subaru knew that it was difficult when he just simply told Rem, who had no Memories and a nose that could only perceive the miasma Subaru was clad in, to believe in him, so even though it was painful, he endured it.

Subaru: [Compared to when we couldn’t even have this sort of exchange, it’s seriously a world of difference.]

Rem: […Truly, I don’t understand you.]

Despite her bluntness, it seemed like Rem had indescribably complicated emotions regarding Subaru’s reaction, where the joy seemed to be outweighed by the bitterness.

Even so, the reason she did not completely try to keep him at a distance due to the Miasma, was thanks to the initial incident at the Crystal Palace―― Because she tried to fully accept and understand the dedication shown when, after he had realized they had been sent to a dangerous location, he had volunteered to be a decoy and attempted to help Rem and Louis, well, strictly speaking only Rem, escape.

In actuality, Subaru had ended up Returning by Death so many times that he was really, really relieved that such a threat had not befallen Rem.

That said, he would be overjoyed if they could compromise just a bit more. For example――,

Madelyn: [Oni girl, this dragon has friggin’ returned. Help me with my friggin’ bath.]

Rem: [Of course, Madelyn-san, I understand.]

Something like the relationship between Rem and Madelyn, where unexpectedly, she could calmly respond to those haughty demands with such a tone.

Berstetz: [General First-Class Madelyn and Rem-dono have become quite close.]

Right then, Berstetz said exactly what Subaru had been thinking. Even if he took a glance at the old man’s profile, he could not read anything from his eyes that were so narrow, not even his irises were visible.

Not even whether he welcomes the relationship between them, or dislikes it.

Subaru: [Berstetz-san, you wouldn’t happen to be a demi-human collector , would you?]

Berstetz: [If that means being an antiquarian of precious bloodlines, then I cannot deny it in a broad sense. Powerful species have strong individuals, but contrarily they lack in their ability to protect their bloodlines. For the future of the Empire, we must treat them with care to ensure they are not lost.]

Subaru: [Speaking of the future of the Empire…]

Berstetz: [Are you curious to learn more? Lolimancer-dono of the Kingdom?]

Subaru: [ Don’t need to know …]

Lifting both hands, Subaru indicated he had retracted his careless curiosity.

They say curiosity killed the cat, but in the Empire it was a rule that would seriously not go unpunished.

However――,

Subaru: [Setting aside the dragonkin Madelyn-chan, whether Oni are valuable or not, Rem is my Rem.]

Rem: [Ha? Please don’t say that on your own. I can hear you.]

Subaru: [I didn’t say it so you wouldn’t hear me.]

Louis: [Uu!]

Having sharp ears, Rem caught what was being discussed, and made a complicated face upon hearing Subaru’s response. Why was Louis enjoying hugging her waist, beaming while in a good mood? It was annoying when she would cling to Subaru, but it was mentally draining having her embrace Rem in that way.

Then, it was as Subaru was thinking about tearing Louis away from Rem by force.

???: [Natsuki Subaru-dono, are you here!?]

His name called out so loudly, Subaru’s eyes widened as he wondered what was going on.

When he turned around, the figure of a tall individual was standing at the entrance to the mansion. Seeing it was a fierce-looking young man with short green hair, Subaru pursed his lips.

It was not particularly clear, but he recalled the young man’s face. ――He had been killed by him once before.

Subaru: [I am Natsuki Subaru.]

???: [I am Kafma Irulux, General Second-Class of the glorious Vollachian Empire. Natsuki Subaru-dono, you have been summoned by His Excellency, the Emperor.]

The young man who saluted before Subaru―― Kafma, announced this with a polite bow.

Subaru’s breath caught in his throat when he heard that the Emperor had summoned him. For the Emperor, who spent his time always occupied, to call for him for the first time in days, it would not be without meaning.

That is to say――,

Subaru: [Kafma… san,  do you know why the Emperor has called for me?]

Kafma: [I do not hold the authority to preemptively convey His Excellency the Emperor’s words. His Excellency will reveal to you exactly what you need to know.]

Kafma’s answer was the most military-esque of anyone he had spoken to thus far. With his wholehearted faithfulness and loyalty toward the Emperor, now that man known as the Lion Knight had been imprisoned as a rebel, he seemed to be the only Knight in an Empire without any other.

In any case――,

Subaru: [――Rem, I’m going to go out for a bit. I might be home late, so you can eat dinner without me.]

Rem: [Stop saying nonsensical things… Take care.]

Just that one phrase reluctantly and falteringly added at the end was enough to make him blush, as he was filled with unbelievable energy that he felt would allow him to persevere forever and ever.

△▼△▼△▼△

???: […It is true that I carelessly thought I would be able to get through it no matter what, but…]

???: [What. Do you have any complaints?]

???: [Of course, is that not obviously a given?]

Sitting in a luxurious dragon carriage and resting his head on his knees, Subaru retorted with those words to the Emperor whose cruelty was beyond compare, the one who had asked something so obvious.

The black-haired Emperor, shrugging slightly at Subaru’s objection,

Vincent: [You must be aware of your own circumstances, which are not only complicated, but even ominous, no?]

Subaru: [Ominous is an exaggeration. I am aware of my complicated position, and I feel that I should repay how you have overlooked that for me in some way. But that said…”]

Vincent: [――]

Subaru: [Separating me from Rem, and then taking me so far away is another story altogether!]

Exploding with such displeasure, Subaru was currently accompanying Vincent on an expedition.

Kafma had turned up at Berstetz’s mansion and had brought Subaru to the castle. With as few words as always, Vincent had arrogantly decreed, “Accompany me on my travels.”

Before he realized it, he was carried away just like that and put in a dragon carriage, and now he was here.

Subaru: [Kafma-san said that Your Excellency the Emperor would inform me of anything I needed to know, without hiding anything, and yet?]

Vincent: [Kafma Irulux’s remark was correct. I shall not hesitate to disclose any information that is necessary.]

Subaru: [But despite that, other than that our destination is a city called Chaosflame, I have not heard anything else?]

Vincent: [Is it necessary? For you to have more information than that?]

Subaru: [Of course it is!]

Going on an expedition while knowing nothing but the destination was like a variety show of a bygone era. It would be impossible to do now due to compliance violations of the modern age, as well as due to fears that they might be forced to do hard labour overseas; it could be considered close to a modern shady part-time job.

In either case, it would be out of line ethically.

However, instigator in question, the Emperor himself, sniffed softly,

Vincent: [Looking at your current appearance, I cannot believe that you harbor any anxiety over the future.]

He had declared so indifferently, without hesitation.

Subaru understood what Vincent wanted to say. He was probably referring to what was reflected in his black eyes: the current Subaru―― nay, Natsumi Schwartz.

He was wearing a beautiful long black wig and a red toned military uniform styled to conceal his figure. His makeup was flawless, and he appeared as a perfected lady from any angles.

Subaru/Schwartz: [However, I cannot say I like when people point at me and say suggestive things.]

Vincent: […Is there any point in continuing to put up that act before me, when I know your true identity?]

Subaru/Schwartz: [You can never know when you might be found out. Is this not a good thing? They say that God is in the details, which means devoting yourself with sincerity.]

Vincent: [――――]

Subaru/Schwartz: [To begin with, the reason I am accompanying you like this as Natsumi Schwartz is to comply with the wishes of Your Excellency the Emperor. The circumstances are what they are, but I simply cannot leave any records of myself being involved in something such as a civil war of the Empire.]

Subaru/Schwartz did not know every detail about the friction between the two nations, but he knew that so-called intervention in another country’s domestic affairs and collaboration across national borders could invite bad things, even if it were good deeds, depending on the situation.

Put simply, a Knight with ties to the Kingdom lending a helping hand to the Empire when it is in a crisis―― the difference between a fairy tale and the story of reality was that such a moving tale was inexcusable.

Subaru/Schwartz: [Therefore, I am Natsumi Schwartz.]

Vincent: [――. If you possess no doubts about yourself, I care not. As long as you work properly, I do not intend on putting fetters on any individual hobbies or tastes.]

Subaru/Schwartz: [Hobbies…?]

Vincent: [I do not intend to engage in trivial questioning . You were the one who requested an explanation. If you were that damnable Ubilk, he would not have asked anything, but I suppose you are not.]

Subaru/Schwartz: [It troubles me that you put me alongside that person of ambiguous station. Speaking of, who is that person really? A pro jester beside a medieval king who relieves their boredom?]

Vincent: [It is true that that thing is a jester, but its role is not to stave off my boredom. Of course, the role I expect of you is the same. It was he who nominated you for this expedition after all.]

Subaru/Schwartz: […Ubilk-san, nominated me?]

Recalling the face of the frivolous, effeminate man, Subaru/Schwartz tilted his head.

From the beginning, Ubilk had acted with a mysterious sense of distance toward Subaru/Schwartz. Even more baffling was the reactions of Vincent and other authorities who allowed Ubilk to have an influential voice. Stargazer, that was how Ubilk was addressed. ――If that role was a prophetic position as Subaru/Schwartz vaguely conjectured, then it was a common trope in the settings of fantasy stories.

The problem was that there was a good chance there were actual prophets in this world, and according to words of the effeminate man suspected to be a prophet, he feared they might also suspect him to be one of them as well.

Subaru/Schwartz: [I just cannot believe it is the same thing, but it is frustrating that I cannot explain the reason why.]

Subaru/Schwartz’s Return by Death can, in other words, be said to be seen as anticipating the future.

There was a part of Subaru/Schwartz that thought of it as simply cheating the future, but when he learned of approaching threats through Return by Death and worked out the means to avoid them, it was not very strange that others would think he appeared to be a prophet.

Subaru/Schwartz: [In fact, a bewitching and beautiful prophetess buttering up a powerful individual is a classic among classics. Still, it would be problematic to be misunderstood. …As it is, Return by Death has been behaving oddly.]

The grumbling by Subaru/Schwartz was concerned with the strange phenomenon that was occurring to Return by Death.

Subaru/Schwartz had repeated Return by Death many times before encountering Vincent in the Crystal Palace, but the reason this happened was not only because of the Empire’s national character that did not hesitate to kill, but also because the interval of time between when he died and when he restarted had been so limited.

Of course, the closer the restart point was to Death, the fewer options he had, and the less time there was to enact a plan. The result was that Subaru/Schwartz had experienced many horrific Deaths. This mysterious anomaly that had arisen in Return by Death―― Subaru/Schwartz suspected it might be connected to this not being the Kingdom of Lugunica, but rather the Vollachian Empire.

Subaru/Schwartz: [I do not particularly want to put stock in Echidna’s, or rather that ill-natured Witch’s observation, however…]

If it was the Witch of Envy who made Subaru/Schwartz Return by Death, then the physical distance between the Witch sealed in the eastern end of the Kingdom and Subaru in the Empire had widened. If he considered it simply, then could it not be said that it was becoming harder for the Authority of the Witch to reach him?

If so, then what would happen to Subaru/Schwartz’s Return by Death if, for example, he were to lose his life on the western edge of the Kararagi City-States, the Great Nation of the west? ――He had no means to test it, and did not want to find out.

Subaru/Schwartz: [At any rate, I am being brought here even to the point of separating me from Rem. Then at the very least, I want to do my job. Even if it is annoying, please give me an explanation.]

Vincent: [You issue orders to me, whilst knowing I am the Emperor? I was the one who said that keeping up that clumsy respect was unnecessary, but you have switched quite quickly.]

Subaru/Schwartz: [So far, it seems unlikely that I’ll be killed by a guillotine.]

Vincent: [Guillotine, huh? ――It is ironic that I am reminded of Magrizza’s Guillotine here.]

Subaru/Schwartz: [――?]

Vincent: [That was an unnecessary remark. ――My goal in having you accompany me to the Demon City is not complicated. It is to speak with Yorna Mishigure, one of the Nine Divine Generals.]

Subaru/Schwartz: [Yorna Mishigure… If I recall, she is nicknamed the Flamboyant.]

Subaru/Schwartz put the results of him diligently gathering intelligence rather than just playing around into words. With a face that held no real emotion toward that, Vincent said nothing and calmly lowered his chin.

Subaru thought it was likely that the attitude of this Emperor who was truly inept at meeting the needs of his subordinates for approval might have been the cause as for why the person known as Goz had rebelled.

Putting Subaru’s suspicions aside, Vincent began to speak matter-of-factly.

What he said was――,

Vincent: [Arakiya, whom I had sent to suppress the rebels, has not returned. We should assume that in all likelihood, she has either been killed or detained.]

Subaru/Schwartz: [――Hk, Arakiya-chan might have!?]

As this unexpected news was announced, Subaru/Schwartz opened his eyes adorned with straightened lashes in surprise.

Although he had not had a chance to meet Arakiya since that first day, he had felt a one-sided sense of gratitude toward her. ――This was because when Subaru/Schwartz had encountered Vincent, given his name, and the table for negotiations had been laid out, he had asked via Vincent to ensure Rem’s safety, and it was Arakiya who had accomplished this brilliantly.

If Rem had been discovered by any of the individuals who had mercilessly taken Subaru/Schwartz’s life, an unforgivable disaster may have befallen her by now.

That was why Subaru/Schwartz thought of Arakiya as someone he was indebted to.

Subaru/Schwartz: [Why did you not tell me!?]

Vincent: [There should be no expectation I would. She is a General First-Class of the Empire, her actions are a state secret. Think of me informing you like this now as an exception.]

Subaru/Schwartz: [――――]

Vincent: [Since the First cannot be used now for various reasons, Arakiya, who is the Second, was the strongest military force of the Empire. If it has become the case that Arakiya can no longer be used, we need the Nine Divine Generals to be cautious in expressing their positions, including on the matter of Goz Ralfon.]

Subaru/Schwartz: [For that reason…]

Vincent: [Exactly.]

Vincent nodded, arms crossed, as Subaru/Schwartz lowered his head.

In his chest, his heart was resounding coldly in pain, and even now, he still could not fully process the misfortune that had befallen Arakiya.

He could understand Vincent’s point. However, what if Vincent had shared the truth with him immediately as soon as something had happened to Arakiya?

Subaru/Schwartz: [With Return by Death…]

He might have been able to save Arakiya.

Given the matter of her safety was unknown, he knew it was a premature conclusion, but Subaru/Schwartz could not help but have the possibility flash through his mind.

Subaru/Schwartz: [Besides, regarding the individual known as Yorna Mishigure, as far as I know…]

Vincent: [She has raised rebellions against me twice in the past.]

Subaru/Schwartz: [Right!? With such circumstances, is it fine for you to meet such a person face-to-face?]

Subaru/Schwartz had learned over the past few days that Vincent Vollachia’s reign had already lasted eight years, apparently being an exceptionally peaceful era in the history of the Empire up to now, and Vincent was called the Wise Emperor by his subjects, gaining their approval.

During Vincent’s reign, there was one person not easily swayed, raising rebellions in the true sense of the word, and repeatedly clashing with him: Yorna Mishigure, the Flamboyant.

Subaru/Schwartz: [As far as I know, would they not clearly be the kind of person who would take advantage of this situation?]

Vincent: [To make certain of this, is the reason why I am going myself. That is all.]

Subaru/Schwartz: [The one with an irreplaceable position taking the initiative… the spirit of the Empire, it is quite impressive.]

As Subaru/Schwartz’s shoulders drooped in dejection, Vincent said “ Speerit ?” with a reaction like he was stuck on a word he was not used to hearing.

To exact a modicum of revenge, Subaru/Schwartz decided to not translate the modern language unless asked, and looking out the window of the moving dragon carriage, he kept the work that was expected of him in the Demon City locked up tight in his heart.

Putting aside the expectations of the recommender, Ubilk, Vincent’s expectations of Subaru/Schwartz were, to put it bluntly, more or less as that of a backup plan.

He was unsure the extent of which the achievements of Subaru/Schwartz of the Kingdom of Lugunica were known in the Vollachian Empire, but no matter what embellished or exaggerated rumors had spread, anyone who saw the real Subaru/Schwartz would surely be disappointed to learn that he was not such an outstanding person.

On the other hand, if the facts connected to those deeds cannot be ignored, it could be said that the best role he can be expected to fulfill is that of being a backup plan.

Thus, Subaru/Schwartz wanted to slap his cheeks, but stopped, afraid of possibly ruining his makeup. Instead, while brushing his long, lustrous hair in a feminine manner,

Subaru/Schwartz: [I understand, Your Excellency the Emperor. For now, I shall do everything within my power to bring you back unharmed to the Imperial Capital no matter what happens. Being the back-up is my specialty!]

Vincent: [――. I have no idea what in the world has gotten you so fired up, but endeavor to do so with all you have. Do not forget that what is precious to you is being kept hostage at Berstetz’s manor.]

Subaru/Schwartz: [You do not need to go out of your way to threaten me; Emilia-tan, Beako, and Rem are constantly in the back of my mind at all times!]

He had just started to build up his motivation without any such threats, and yet now His Excellency the Emperor had unnecessarily dampened that motivation. ――Given that he angered the kind Goz Ralfon who was so well-regarded, perhaps it was Vincent’s fault after all.

With that tinge of anxiety in his chest, Subaru/Schwartz completed his journey to his destination of the Demon City Chaosflame with no complications.

And then――,

△▼△▼△▼△

???: [Enemy of my late sister ――Black haired, black-eyed, traveler !!]

She had been a woman with the tips of her black hair dyed blue, and a brave yet fierce hatred within her eyes.

Immediately after the string of her bow that she had drawn back with great force had bent, and the sound of it cutting through the air had been heard, Subaru/Schwartz had been sent flying away from beside the Emperor’s shoulder, and his side had been pulverized by the arrow.

Subaru/Schwartz: [――Guh.]

The welling blood filled his throat, and Subaru/Schwartz fell as he experienced the sensation of drowning.

Witnessing this scene, the Emperor who had been protected ――Vincent Vollachia, grimaced as he rushed to Subaru/Schwartz, whose blood spread upon the bare earth.

Vincent: [Natsumi Schwartz! You… are out of character…!]

Subaru/Schwartz: [You say… that it is… out of character… It is my… motto to do one good deed a day…]

Vincent: [Even now, you do not stop running your mouth… Tch, this is a severe injury.]

Placing his hands over the open wound to try and stop the oozing blood, and then perceiving that the flesh of the side he touched was not all there, Subaru/Schwartz regretted his awareness of his wound.

The side of his abdomen had been blown away. No matter how he looked at it, it was a fatal wound, one he could not expect to survive. However, Vincent picked up Subaru/Schwartz’s body, and began to move.

Subaru/Schwartz: [What… are you doing… If you do not… run…]

Vincent: [I have no objections. Hence, I am doing exactly that. You can just admire the sky.]

Subaru/Schwartz: [The sky… Your unnecessary comments… just make my injuries worse…]

While he answered with a hollow voice, Subaru/Schwartz looked up into the skies of Chaosflame.

The city of Chaosflame was unique in how the great diversity of tribes that lived in the Demon City and all their respective architectural styles had become intertwined as if they had forgotten the spirit of compromise, with their implementation of urban development like a potpourri. ――Now, it was a mere shadow of its former self.

What swept across the city now was not a scene of the liberation of freedoms accumulated on top of each other, but a battle of transcendent beings beyond all human understanding that demolished, twisted, and shattered those streets.

???: [Kakakakka! I never thought we’d clash like this, Araki!]

???: [If you don’t like it, back off.]

???: [Are you giving orders like you own this city? Who do you think is the lord of this place?]

Numerous flaming explosions spread throughout the air, and the shadow of a monstrous old man used the roof of a building as a foothold as he soared about. Flying after him in pursuit was a doggirl whose legs below the knees had been replaced with flames. And the two who were clashing together were interrupted by a courtesan-like foxperson who used an undulating steel tower as a foothold to remold the town――,

――The Vicious Old Man, Olbart Dunkelkenn.

――The Spirit Eater, Arakiya.

――The Flamboyant, Yorna Mishigure.

Known for their unrivaled prowess, these fierce warriors were among the apex of the Vollachian Empire, the Nine Divine Generals.

All three were a part of different camps, and their battle unfolded upon the stage of Chaosflame.

Vincent: [Certainly, I never thought Arakiya would join them. ――Not foreseeing her participation, was mine own error.]

Bathed in waves of heat and force that churned through the atmosphere, Vincent ran through the rough streets while carrying Subaru/Schwartz, in an attempt to get away from the battlefield.

The strongest asset that Vincent had brought with him to the Demon City was Olbart, who had no leeway to pay attention to them, laughing as he aimed for the lives of the two women.

Meanwhile, the mistress of the Demon City, Yorna, was working to fulfill her duty of nonaggressive defense.

Finally, Arakiya, who had been sent out to suppress the rebels, but had been believed to be lost in action, was――,

???: [――Vincent Vollachia!]

Vincent: [――――]

His name called out, Vincent stopped in his tracks and turned around.

Ahead of him, the owner of that voice stood motionless atop the rubble of a collapsed building. ――Oddly enough, it was a slender man with black hair adorned in red attire, just like Vincent. However, he hid his true identity with a mask that resembled the face of an Oni, and was the leader of the rebels.

This man in the oni mask, who was believed to have conspired with General First-Class Goz Ralfon and intended to take Vincent’s throne, had paid a visit at the same time as Vincent and Subaru/Schwartz had arrived in Chaosflame to inquire as to the intentions of Yorna, the Seventh.

And then, he tried to invite Yorna to become his ally in the war that he led to steal the country.

Needless to say, they could not afford for negotiations between Yorna and the man in the oni mask and his party to go well. Subaru/Schwartz and the rest had to obstruct the negotiations, and headed to the location of the discussions――,

Vincent: [What do you call yourself, you traitor?]

Masked Man: [――Abel. My current self, is Abel.]

As he confronted Vincent, the man in the oni mask―― Abel, declared his name, and the air was set alight.

The heat of the tense atmosphere between them emitted a scorching aroma, and the fighting spirit of Abel, accompanied by Arakiya, who had supposedly disappeared, caused the Demon City to collapse.

If it was the case that Yorna Mishigure, taking an uncertain position, would not declare her position in joining either the Emperor or the rebels, then the best policy was to ensure that she would not fall to the other side.

The moment that possibility passed, the battle between those transcendental beings had begun.

Vincent: [Abel…]

Vincent narrowed his eyes, and uttered the name as if to confirm it.

Having lost copious amounts of blood, Subaru/Schwartz was on the brink of losing his life; he had no way of guessing what was going through Vincent’s mind right now.

However, Abel’s other companion did not overlook that moment of hesitation.

???: [――――]

As Vincent faced Abel, a merciless assassin jumped out from behind some rubble to his rear, sneaking up on him without any sound or presence.

He aimed his axe at the neck of the motionless Vincent from behind――,

???: [――Your Excellency!!]

Just before the axe could sever Vincent’s slender neck, it was intercepted by a fierce surge of purple thorns.

The one who had raised his voice, saving the Emperor from the surprise attack, while bleeding profusely all over his body, was Kafma. Kafma, the final member of Vincent’s escorts, had put to good use the special characteristics of the Insect Cage Tribe, using the insects he had taken into his body to pursue the enemies who had attempted to commit regicide against the Emperor.

However――,

???: [OOORAAAA!!]

The enemy jumped and ducked, avoiding the extending thorny whips, and a new figure landed beside him, swinging the two longswords in his hands, cutting the thorns head-on and mowing down the threat.

They were a man wearing a bandana with an axe and a rough-looking dual-wielding swordsman with a patch over his right eye. ――Both were members of the rebels who had accompanied Abel.

Bandana Man: [――My bad, my bad.]

Rough Man: [Tch! Oi, don’t mess up your only skill!]

Bandana Man: [Saying it’s my only skill hurts, you know? But your backup saved me. Can I continue to count on you?]

Rough Man: [You’re a hopeless bastard. ――General Second-Class, Kafma Irulux. For an opponent, I can’t complain.]

The dual-wielding swordsman laughed as he cracked his neck, and the man in the bandana beside him turned his frigid eyes toward Vincent and Subaru/Schwartz. As if to block their view, a battered Kafma stood between the two enemies and Vincent.

Kafma: [Please leave this place to me! Your Excellency, take Miss Schwartz!]

Vincent: [Do not overextend yourself. Olbart’s hands are tied. There are also the eyes of the Shudraq.]

Kafma: [I understand, sir! …I will not let the lives saved by Miss Schwartz, let alone His Excellency Vincent, be scattered in vain!]

Kafma, wounded all over his body, took on his task with vigor, and so Vincent left that situation to him, and began to run.

This time, he was prepared to leave no matter what Abel said, and perhaps because he understood this, Abel did not say anything more atop the rubble. With that, the two enemies vying for the throne departed that place.

And then――,

Vincent: [――Natsuki Subaru, Stargazer of the Kingdom. If you were to die, I know not with what to fill this gap. Therefore…]

Subaru/Schwartz: [――Ugh.]

The battlefield was far off, and as he heard his ears ring loudly, yet the sound of his heartbeat grow quiet in contrast, Subaru/Schwartz saw Vincent put his hands to his own face.

As Vincent shut his eyes like that, despite his consciousness fading to white, Subaru/Schwartz suddenly realized something. ――Until now, he had never once seen Vincent close both of his eyes.

But then, those thoughts immediately vanished due to a series of strange occurrences.

Vincent: [――Mask of the Blue.]

As he murmured that, Vincent’s face peeled off before the eyes of Subaru/Schwartz.

While producing a sound that would make one wince just from hearing it, like flesh tearing off the bone, like skin tearing off from flesh, Vincent’s face peeled off.

The flayed face of Vincent, pulled off like a “mask”, slowly disintegrated in his hands and turned to dust.

Subaru: [――――]

The scene was just like a nightmare during a restless night, or a glitch in one’s brain as they were about to face Death. However, the Emperor, now stripped of his face, brought his other hand to his face and put on the next “mask”.

The next moment, Vincent’s body made a noise, his skeleton began to thin, and his height began to shrink. Not only that, but his hair color and style, that form was slowly remade――,

Subaru/Schwartz: […Ferris?]

A beat later, standing there was a distinctive face he recognized, with adorable features and cat ears, who should have been constantly attending to his lord in the Kingdom of Lugunica; it was the form of Ferris.

Subaru: [――――]

――Vincent had turned into Ferris.

Subaru/Schwartz was left speechless by that sight, which could only be described in such a manner. However, the person in question paid no heed to Subaru/Schwartz’s confusion, placing a pale hand over his wound.

Immediately after, a faint light flowed out, and the side of Subaru/Schwartz that had been blown away began to heal. ――That transcendental healing power that seemed to turn back time was unmistakably Ferris’s.

The flesh near at the opening of the wound swelled, and the restoration of his internal organs and muscle fibers commenced. The blood that had poured out did not return, but his body, being invigorated, entered a phase of blood production, and his circulation remarkably improved.

His consciousness, which should have been fading, began to steadily regain its color, and Subaru/Schwartz ――no, Natsuki Subaru, while still pretending to be a woman, reached up with his hand to the shoulder before him.

He grabbed that thin shoulder and pulled it close, and glaring at the person healing him,

Subaru: [You… Are you, Capella?]

“Ferris”: [For what reason, such doubts have arisen, I cannot fathom, but… no.]

That face and voice were Ferris’s own, and yet the language was that of Vincent. Subaru’s breath caught at that sense of incongruity and he slowly shook his head.

In the instant Ferris lowered his gaze, cracks suddenly formed across his face.

Subaru: [――Hk!]

The cracks began on the cheeks, and then expanded bit by bit, slowly damaging Ferris’s sweet face.

“Ferris”: [I shall use the stagnant Mana within you that has had no place to go. If things had continued this way, the plug would have failed and burst anyways. I shall hear no complaints.]

However, seeming to feel no pain himself, and paying Subaru’s reaction of astonishment no heed, the fake Ferris ignored the cracks on his face and continued to heal Subaru’s side.

The faint light of recovery, healed, healed, healed the wounds, and shortly――,

“Ferris”: [It is done.]

As soon as he stated that, the cracks reached the entirety of the face of the fake Ferris.

Just as the peeled face of Vincent had turned to dust before, the face of the fake Ferris also crumbled from the edges, becoming dust as well.

Although his wounds had been healed and his life had been saved, Subaru could only lie there while facing a nightmare not all that different from one that had threatened his life before.

From beneath the face of the fake Ferris that flaked away, a new face ――neither Vincent nor the fake Ferris, but instead an unknown face emerged. ――No, it was not unknown to him.

Once before, only for a brief moment, had Subaru caught a glimpse of that face.

Since he had been in the middle of a crisis, he had not questioned that optical illusion very deeply, but he had seen that face in a mirror in the Imperial Residence.

A tall figure with long white hair and white skin that seemed to have lost all of their color, while his whole body was composed of simply white, only his irises sparkled with the hue of gold. This person was――,

Pale Man: [――Chisha Gold.]

Subaru: [Huh?]

Chisha: [You seem to have confused me with another individual, therefore I responded.]

A man of nothing but white appeared ――introducing himself as Chisha Gold, Subaru belatedly realized this was his answer to Subaru’s mention of Capella earlier.

That power, which allowed him to transform his appearance to someone else in front of Subaru’s very eyes, and even heal a fatal wound in the form of Ferris, was no mere imitation or disguise.

Subaru: [Wait, Chisha Gold, isn’t that one of the Nine Divine Generals…]

Chisha: [Allow me to confirm that. I have been bestowed with the rank of the Fourth, of the Nine Divine Generals, and therefore I am made to serve to the best of my meager ability as a General First-Class of the Empire.]

Subaru: […Are you, the Emperor’s body double?]

Chisha: [When emergencies arise. That said, that would not be correct in this case. The most suitable way to describe me currently, that would be――]

In front of Subaru, frozen and wide-eyed, Chisha, with his only dress still being the clothes of the Emperor, narrowed his golden eyes with an expression full of hard to read emotions, and made a declaration.

Chisha: [――Usurper of the throne of the Vollachian Empire, and rebel who mocks the Sword Wolf.]

That was truly the first meeting of Natsuki Subaru and the White Spider, Chisha Gold. ――It was the true first meeting of those two, who by all rights should have never had their destinies converge, companions who would deceive fate.

△▼△▼△▼△

Chisha explained that his power to change his form was called Noh. [2]

He said that its detailed principles were difficult to explain, but by stealing the color of a target he wanted to become and wearing the “mask” produced, he could take on their very identity itself.

Using this, Chisha had acted as the Emperor in the guise of Vincent Vollachia, and even completely healed Subaru’s wounds using the “mask” of Ferris, whom he had a previous connection with.

Hearing this explanation, for now, Subaru was simply relieved to confirm that Chisha was not the Sin Archbishop of Lust, Capella, but another thought crossed his mind.

Subaru: [If I’m not mistaken, doesn’t this mean that that Goz Ralfon person who’s being held as a rebel got in your way because he figured out you replaced the Emperor?]

Subaru: [Of course, I had a feeling! No wonder, no matter how much information I gathered, I could only come to the conclusion that this Goz person wasn’t someone who would betray the Emperor. In reality, he didn’t betray him!]

Snapping his fingers, Subaru smiled in satisfaction that he was correct in his thinking. ――But after a moment of gratification, that smile faded.

After all, Chisha had clearly told Subaru. ――He was the usurper of the throne, and the mastermind of a rebellion that was causing the Vollachian Empire to fall into chaos and futility.

Subaru: […If it’s the way of the Empire that the strong preying on the weak is allowed, is challenging the Emperor, challenging Vincent Vollachia, due to your ambition as a man of the Empire?]

Subaru: [――. I think that’s probably incorrect.]

In the first place, if the way of the Vollachian Empire was such that by defeating Vincent with his own hands, Chisha could replace the summit of the country of the Sword Wolves, then it was a flawed system. Despite that, Chisha had taken the form of Vincent, hidden the absence of the Emperor, and maintained that situation.

There was no sense of sincerity toward a simplistic objective like usurping the throne in that.

Subaru: […Ultimately, your goal isn’t the throne… but I can’t figure out the rest.]

He was aware that both of those were somewhat fragile lifelines to fully depend on. But Subaru had faith that the Chisha who had saved him and even purposefully revealed top-secret information would not do something so meaningless as suddenly changing his mind and attacking him.

In response to Subaru’s convenient question, Chisha calmly lowered his chin, and,

Chisha: [In order to save the Empire from a future of ruin, I am employing the necessary means.]

There is no doubt it shall be the most efficient method, and the one that shall deplete the fewest resources, therefore no one can defy His Excellency.]

As Chisha nodded in agreement, Subaru touched his own side, and thought it over.

By saving Subaru with his trump card, Chisha had exposed his own schemes. If there was some lie or artifice there, Subaru could not maliciously doubt him. There was nothing about Subaru worth devoting that hand just to lay a trap for him.

From beginning to end, Chisha saw value in and had determined the Emperor and Empire as that which must be saved.

His actions that no one could comprehend stood upon two pillars of certainty.

Subaru: [There’s just one thing I want to confirm.]

Chisha: [――I am afraid, I must deny that.]

Chisha informed him of this in a hushed voice, and Subaru sighed with an “I thought so.”

The “mask” of Vincent he had torn off and the “mask” of Ferris that had cracked, both had vanished in the end by turning into dust. He had a sense that it had been something that should be called a disappearance or loss, that it was not the type of ability where it could be used over and over again; somehow he had possessed that intuition.

Chisha’s goal was the existence of Vincent Vollachia.

For that purpose, Chisha, who had been wearing the “mask” of Vincent, put on the “mask” of Ferris that could heal even fatal wounds with its vast restorative power, and relinquished both “masks”.

One that was essential for that goal, and one that could become an emergency trump card, respectively.

If he had gone that far to save his life, it would be impossible for Natsuki Subaru. ――Impossible for him to not feel any sort of gratitude toward the one who did so.

Subaru: [Please, tell me more, Chisha-san.]

More than aware of that unreasonable logic, Subaru declared this to Chisha.

If there was ruin on the horizon that Vincent Vollachia, renowned as the Wise Emperor, and Chisha Gold, who was clearly clever, were both trying to oppose, then surely there would be an opportunity for Subaru with his meager power to assist them. ――No, Subaru would go and seize such an opportunity with his own limbs.

That was because――,

Chisha: [――The Great Disaster.]

His face lacked all color, yet his voice harbored a certain fervor.

Chisha: [I shall take measures to save the Vollachian Empire from this Great Disaster. Therefore, there is a board and pieces I must set up for that purpose.]

However, whether he wanted to or not, he could not abandon the Vollachian Empire and Chisha.

Chisha, who was sincerely close to the hearts of the soldiers in the field, and the Empress Consort candidate who was ignorant of the realities of the field, Subaru/Schwartz.
